"use client";

export default function CadastroPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const supabase = createSupabaseBrowserClient();

  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState("");
  const [acceptedTerms, setAcceptedTerms] = useState(false);

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  async function handleSignup(
    event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>,
  ) {
    event.preventDefault();

    setMessage("");
    setError("");

    const normalizedName = name.trim();
    const normalizedEmail = email.trim();

    if (!normalizedName) {
      setError("Informe seu nome completo.");
      return;
    }

    if (password.length < 8) {
      setError("A senha precisa ter pelo menos 8 caracteres.");
      return;
    }

    if (password !== confirmPassword) {
      setError("As senhas nÃ£o conferem.");
      return;
    }

    if (!acceptedTerms) {
      setError(
        "Ã‰ necessÃ¡rio aceitar os Termos de Uso e estar ciente da PolÃ­tica de Privacidade.",
      );
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);

    const { error: signupError } =
      await supabase.auth.signUp({
        email: normalizedEmail,
        password,
        options: {
          data: {
            full_name: normalizedName,
            user_type: "client",
          },
        },
      });

    if (signupError) {
      setError(
        `NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel criar a conta: ${signupError.message}`,
      );
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    setMessage(
      "Conta criada com sucesso. VocÃª jÃ¡ pode entrar na VemGO.",
    );

    setLoading(false);

    setTimeout(() => {
      router.replace("/login");
    }, 1500);
  }

  function handleProfessionalSignup() {
    router.push("/cadastro-profissional");
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-black px-6 py-10 text-white">
      <div className="mx-auto flex min-h-[85vh] max-w-md flex-col justify-center">
        <div className="mb-8 text-center">

"use client";

import Image from "next/image";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { createSupabaseBrowserClient } from "@/lib/supabase-browser";

type ProfessionalRegion = {
  id: string;
  professional_id: string;
  city: string;
  state: string;
  country: string;
  max_distance_km: number;
  is_active: boolean;
};

export default function CadastroProfissionalAreaAtendimentoPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const supabase = createSupabaseBrowserClient();

  const [userId, setUserId] = useState("");
  const [regionId, setRegionId] = useState("");

  const [city, setCity] = useState("");
  const [state, setState] = useState("");
  const [country, setCountry] = useState("BR");
  const [distance, setDistance] = useState("20");

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    async function loadRegion() {
      setLoading(true);
      setError("");

      const {
        data: { user },
        error: userError,
      } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

      if (userError || !user) {
        router.replace("/login");
        return;
      }

      setUserId(user.id);

      const { data: region, error: regionError } =
        await supabase
          .from("professional_regions")
          .select(
            "id, professional_id, city, state, country, max_distance_km, is_active",
          )
          .eq("professional_id", user.id)
          .eq("is_active", true)
          .order("created_at", { ascending: true })
          .limit(1)
          .maybeSingle();

      if (regionError) {
        setError(
          `NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel carregar sua Ã¡rea de atendimento: ${regionError.message}`,
        );
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      if (region) {
        const typedRegion = region as ProfessionalRegion;

        setRegionId(typedRegion.id);
        setCity(typedRegion.city || "");
        setState(typedRegion.state || "");
        setCountry(typedRegion.country || "BR");
        setDistance(
          String(typedRegion.max_distance_km ?? 20),
        );
      }

      setLoading(false);
    }

    void loadRegion();
  }, [router, supabase]);

  async function handleSave() {
    setError("");
    setMessage("");

    const normalizedCity = city.trim();
    const normalizedState = state.trim().toUpperCase();
    const normalizedCountry = country.trim().toUpperCase();
    const numericDistance = Number(distance);

    if (!userId) {
      setError("UsuÃ¡rio nÃ£o identificado.");
      return;
    }

    if (!normalizedCity) {
      setError("Informe sua cidade de atendimento.");
      return;
    }

    if (!normalizedState) {
      setError("Informe seu estado.");
      return;
    }

    if (
      !Number.isFinite(numericDistance) ||
      numericDistance <= 0 ||
      numericDistance > 200
    ) {
      setError(
        "Informe um raio de atendimento entre 1 e 200 km.",
      );
      return;
    }

    setSaving(true);

    let saveError = null;

    if (regionId) {
      const { error: updateError } = await supabase
        .from("professional_regions")
        .update({
          city: normalizedCity,
          state: normalizedState,
          country: normalizedCountry || "BR",
          max_distance_km: numericDistance,
          is_active: true,
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        })
        .eq("id", regionId)
        .eq("professional_id", userId);

      saveError = updateError;
    } else {
      const { data, error: insertError } = await supabase
        .from("professional_regions")
        .insert({
          professional_id: userId,
          city: normalizedCity,
          state: normalizedState,
          country: normalizedCountry || "BR",
          max_distance_km: numericDistance,
          is_active: true,
        })
        .select("id")
        .single();

      saveError = insertError;

      if (data?.id) {
        setRegionId(data.id);
      }
    }

    if (saveError) {
      setError(
        `NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel salvar sua Ã¡rea de atendimento: ${saveError.message}`,
      );
      setSaving(false);
      return;
    }

    setMessage("Ãrea de atendimento salva com sucesso.");
    setSaving(false);

    setTimeout(() => {
      router.push("/cadastro-profissional/plano");
    }, 800);
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-zinc-950 px-6 py-10 text-white">
      <div className="mx-auto flex min-h-[85vh] max-w-md flex-col justify-center">
        <div className="mb-8 text-center">
          <Image
            src="/logo-vemgo.png"
            alt="VemGO"
            width={360}
            height={200}
            className="mx-auto h-auto w-[190px] object-contain"
            priority
          />

          <p className="mt-6 text-sm font-medium text-orange-400">
            Etapa 8 de 9
          </p>

          <div className="mx-auto mt-3 flex max-w-xs gap-1.5">
            {Array.from({ length: 8 }).map((_, index) => (
              <div
                key={index}
                className="h-1.5 flex-1 rounded-full bg-orange-500"
              />
            ))}
          </div>

          <h1 className="mt-8 text-3xl font-bold">
            Ãrea de atendimento
          </h1>

          <p className="mt-3 text-sm leading-6 text-zinc-400">
            Defina onde vocÃª deseja receber oportunidades de
            serviÃ§os pela VemGO.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-zinc-800 bg-black p-6 shadow-sm">
          {loading ? (
            <div className="py-12 text-center text-sm text-zinc-400">
              Carregando sua Ã¡rea de atendimento...
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              <div>
                <label
                  htmlFor="city"
                  className="text-sm font-medium text-white"
                >
                  Cidade
                </label>

                <input
                  id="city"
                  type="text"
                  value={city}
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    setCity(event.target.value)
                  }
                  placeholder="Ex.: JaÃº"
                  className="mt-2 w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-900 px-4 py-3 text-white outline-none transition placeholder:text-zinc-600 focus:border-orange-500"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="mt-5">
                <label
                  htmlFor="state"
                  className="text-sm font-medium text-white"
                >
                  Estado
                </label>

                <input
                  id="state"
                  type="text"
                  maxLength={2}
                  value={state}
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    setState(
                      event.target.value
                        .replace(/[^a-zA-Z]/g, "")
                        .toUpperCase(),
                    )
                  }
                  placeholder="SP"
                  className="mt-2 w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-900 px-4 py-3 text-white uppercase outline-none transition placeholder:text-zinc-600 focus:border-orange-500"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="mt-5">
                <label
                  htmlFor="distance"
                  className="text-sm font-medium text-white"
                >
                  Raio de atendimento
                </label>

                <div className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-3">
                  <input
                    id="distance"
                    type="number"
                    min="1"
                    max="200"
                    step="1"
                    value={distance}
                    onChange={(event) =>
                      setDistance(event.target.value)
                    }
                    className="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-900 px-4 py-3 text-white outline-none transition focus:border-orange-500"
                  />

                  <span className="text-sm text-zinc-400">
                    km
                  </span>
                </div>

                <p className="mt-2 text-xs leading-5 text-zinc-500">
                  VocÃª receberÃ¡ oportunidades dentro desse

              </div>

              <div className="mt-6 rounded-xl border border-orange-900/50 bg-orange-950/20 px-4 py-4">

"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import Image from "next/image";
import { createSupabaseBrowserClient } from "@/lib/supabase-browser";
import { OnboardingStepper } from "@/components/vemgo/OnboardingStepper";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";

type Service = {
  id: string;
  code: string;
  name: string;
  description: string | null;
  category_id: string;
};

export default function CadastroProfissionalCompetenciasPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const supabase = createSupabaseBrowserClient();

  const [userId, setUserId] = useState("");
  const [services, setServices] = useState<Service[]>([]);
  const [selectedServices, setSelectedServices] = useState<string[]>(
    [],
  );

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    async function loadData() {
      setLoading(true);
      setError("");

      const {
        data: { user },
        error: userError,
      } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

      if (cancelled) return;

      if (userError || !user) {
        router.replace("/login");
        return;
      }

      setUserId(user.id);

      const { data: serviceData, error: serviceError } =
        await supabase
          .from("services")
          .select(
            "id, code, name, description, category_id",
          )
          .eq("is_active", true)
          .order("name", { ascending: true });

      if (cancelled) return;

      if (serviceError) {
        setError(
          `NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel carregar os serviÃ§os: ${serviceError.message}`,
        );
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      setServices(serviceData ?? []);

      const {
        data: professionalServices,
        error: professionalError,
      } = await supabase
        .from("professional_services")
        .select("service_id")
        .eq("professional_id", user.id);

      if (cancelled) return;

      if (professionalError) {
        setError(
          `NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel carregar suas competÃªncias: ${professionalError.message}`,
        );
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      setSelectedServices(
        (professionalServices ?? []).map(
          (item) => item.service_id,
        ),
      );

      setLoading(false);
    }

    void loadData();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [router, supabase]);

  const groupedServices = useMemo(() => {
    const groups = new Map<string, Service[]>();

    for (const service of services) {
      const current =
        groups.get(service.category_id) ?? [];

      current.push(service);
      groups.set(service.category_id, current);
    }

    return Array.from(groups.entries());
  }, [services]);

  function toggleService(serviceId: string) {
    setError("");
    setMessage("");

    setSelectedServices((current) => {
      if (current.includes(serviceId)) {
        return current.filter((id) => id !== serviceId);
      }

      return [...current, serviceId];
    });
  }

  async function handleSubmit(
    event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>,
  ) {
    event.preventDefault();

    setError("");
    setMessage("");

    if (!userId) {
      setError("UsuÃ¡rio nÃ£o identificado.");
      return;
    }

    if (selectedServices.length === 0) {
      setError(
        "Selecione pelo menos um serviÃ§o que vocÃª estÃ¡ habilitado a executar.",
      );
      return;
    }

    setSaving(true);

    try {
      const { error: deleteError } = await supabase
        .from("professional_services")
        .delete()
        .eq("professional_id", userId);

      if (deleteError) {
        throw new Error(
          `NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel atualizar suas competÃªncias: ${deleteError.message}`,
        );
      }

      const rows = selectedServices.map((serviceId) => ({
        professional_id: userId,
        service_id: serviceId,
      }));

      const { error: insertError } = await supabase
        .from("professional_services")
        .insert(rows);

      if (insertError) {
        throw new Error(
          `NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel salvar suas competÃªncias: ${insertError.message}`,
        );
      }

      const { error: onboardingError } = await supabase
        .from("profiles")
        .update({
          professional_onboarding_step: 6,
        })
        .eq("id", userId);

      if (onboardingError) {
        throw new Error(
          `NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel atualizar o progresso do cadastro: ${onboardingError.message}`,
        );
      }

"use client";

import Image from "next/image";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { createSupabaseBrowserClient } from "@/lib/supabase-browser";

type Day = {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  enabled: boolean;
  start: string;
  end: string;
};

const initialDays: Day[] = [
  { id: 1, name: "Segunda-feira", enabled: false, start: "08:00", end: "18:00" },
  { id: 2, name: "TerÃ§a-feira", enabled: false, start: "08:00", end: "18:00" },
  { id: 3, name: "Quarta-feira", enabled: false, start: "08:00", end: "18:00" },
  { id: 4, name: "Quinta-feira", enabled: false, start: "08:00", end: "18:00" },
  { id: 5, name: "Sexta-feira", enabled: false, start: "08:00", end: "18:00" },
  { id: 6, name: "SÃ¡bado", enabled: false, start: "08:00", end: "12:00" },
  { id: 0, name: "Domingo", enabled: false, start: "08:00", end: "12:00" },
];

export default function CadastroProfissionalDisponibilidadePage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const supabase = createSupabaseBrowserClient();

  const [days, setDays] = useState<Day[]>(initialDays);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    async function loadAvailability() {
      setLoading(true);
      setError("");

      const {
        data: { user },
      } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

      if (!user) {
        router.replace("/login");
        return;
      }

      const { data, error: availabilityError } = await supabase
        .from("professional_availability")
        .select("day_of_week,start_time,end_time,is_active")
        .eq("professional_id", user.id);

      if (availabilityError) {
        setError(
          `NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel carregar sua disponibilidade: ${availabilityError.message}`,
        );
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      if (data && data.length > 0) {
        setDays((current) =>
          current.map((day) => {
            const saved = data.find(
              (item) => item.day_of_week === day.id,
            );

            if (!saved) {
              return day;
            }

            return {
              ...day,
              enabled: saved.is_active,
              start: saved.start_time?.slice(0, 5) || day.start,
              end: saved.end_time?.slice(0, 5) || day.end,
            };
          }),
        );
      }

      setLoading(false);
    }

    void loadAvailability();
  }, [router, supabase]);

  function toggleDay(dayId: number) {
    setDays((current) =>
      current.map((day) =>
        day.id === dayId
          ? { ...day, enabled: !day.enabled }
          : day,
      ),
    );
  }

  function updateTime(
    dayId: number,
    field: "start" | "end",
    value: string,
  ) {
    setDays((current) =>
      current.map((day) =>
        day.id === dayId
          ? { ...day, [field]: value }
          : day,
      ),
    );
  }

  async function handleSave() {
    setError("");

    const selectedDays = days.filter((day) => day.enabled);

    if (selectedDays.length === 0) {
      setError("Selecione pelo menos um dia de atendimento.");
      return;
    }

    for (const day of selectedDays) {
      if (!day.start || !day.end) {
        setError(
          `Informe o horÃ¡rio de atendimento de ${day.name}.`,
        );
        return;
      }

      if (day.start >= day.end) {
        setError(
          `O horÃ¡rio final precisa ser maior que o inicial em ${day.name}.`,
        );
        return;
      }
    }

    setSaving(true);

    const {
      data: { user },
    } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

    if (!user) {
      router.replace("/login");
      return;
    }

    const { error: deleteError } = await supabase
      .from("professional_availability")
      .delete()
      .eq("professional_id", user.id);

    if (deleteError) {
      setError(
        `NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel atualizar sua disponibilidade: ${deleteError.message}`,
      );
      setSaving(false);
      return;
    }

    const rows = selectedDays.map((day) => ({
      professional_id: user.id,
      day_of_week: day.id,
      start_time: day.start,
      end_time: day.end,
      is_active: true,
    }));

    const { error: insertError } = await supabase
      .from("professional_availability")
      .insert(rows);

    if (insertError) {
      setError(
        `NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel salvar sua disponibilidade: ${insertError.message}`,
      );
      setSaving(false);
      return;
    }

    router.push("/cadastro-profissional/area-atendimento");
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-zinc-950 px-6 py-10 text-white">
      <div className="mx-auto flex min-h-[85vh] max-w-2xl flex-col justify-center">
        <div className="mb-8 text-center">
          <Image
            src="/logo-vemgo.png"
            alt="VemGO"
            width={360}
            height={200}
            className="mx-auto h-auto w-[190px] object-contain"
            priority
          />

          <p className="mt-6 text-sm font-medium text-orange-400">
            Etapa 7 de 9
          </p>

          <div className="mx-auto mt-3 flex max-w-xs gap-1.5">
            {Array.from({ length: 7 }).map((_, index) => (
              <div
                key={index}
                className="h-1.5 flex-1 rounded-full bg-orange-500"
              />
            ))}
          </div>

          <h1 className="mt-8 text-3xl font-bold">
            Sua disponibilidade
          </h1>

          <p className="mt-3 text-sm leading-6 text-zinc-400">
            Informe os dias e horÃ¡rios em que vocÃª normalmente
            estÃ¡ disponÃ­vel para receber serviÃ§os pela VemGO.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-zinc-800 bg-black p-6 shadow-sm">
          {loading ? (
            <div className="py-12 text-center text-sm text-zinc-400">
              Carregando sua disponibilidade...
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {days.map((day) => (
                  <div
                    key={day.id}
                    className={`rounded-xl border p-4 transition ${
                      day.enabled
                        ? "border-orange-500/60 bg-orange-500/5"
                        : "border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-950"
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
                      <label className="flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-3">
                        <input
                          type="checkbox"
                          checked={day.enabled}
                          onChange={() => toggleDay(day.id)}
                          className="h-5 w-5 accent-orange-500"
                        />

                        <span className="font-semibold">
                          {day.name}
                        </span>
                      </label>

                      {day.enabled && (
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                          <div>
                            <label className="mb-1 block text-xs text-zinc-500">
                              InÃ­cio
                            </label>

                            <input
                              type="time"
                              value={day.start}
                              onChange={(event) =>
                                updateTime(
                                  day.id,
                                  "start",
                                  event.target.value,
                                )
                              }
                              className="rounded-lg border border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-900 px-3 py-2 text-white outline-none focus:border-orange-500"
                            />
                          </div>

                          <span className="mt-5 text-zinc-600">
                            atÃ©

                          <div>

                              Fim

                                  event.target.value,

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { createSupabaseBrowserClient } from "@/lib/supabase-browser";

type ViaCepResponse = {
  cep?: string;
  logradouro?: string;
  complemento?: string;
  bairro?: string;
  localidade?: string;
  uf?: string;
  erro?: boolean;
};

export default function CadastroProfissionalEnderecoPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const supabase = createSupabaseBrowserClient();

  const [cep, setCep] = useState("");
  const [street, setStreet] = useState("");
  const [number, setNumber] = useState("");
  const [complement, setComplement] = useState("");
  const [neighborhood, setNeighborhood] = useState("");
  const [city, setCity] = useState("");
  const [state, setState] = useState("");
  const [country] = useState("Brasil");
  const [serviceRadius, setServiceRadius] = useState("50");

  const [loadingCep, setLoadingCep] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  function formatCep(value: string) {
    const digits = value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 8);

    if (digits.length <= 5) {
      return digits;
    }

    return `${digits.slice(0, 5)}-${digits.slice(5)}`;
  }

  async function searchCep(value: string) {
    const cleanCep = value.replace(/\D/g, "");

    if (cleanCep.length !== 8) {
      return;
    }

    setLoadingCep(true);
    setError("");
    setMessage("");

    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `https://viacep.com.br/ws/${cleanCep}/json/`,
      );

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error("NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel consultar o CEP.");
      }

      const data: ViaCepResponse = await response.json();

      if (data.erro) {
        setError("CEP nÃ£o encontrado.");
        return;
      }

      setStreet(data.logradouro ?? "");
      setNeighborhood(data.bairro ?? "");
      setCity(data.localidade ?? "");
      setState(data.uf ?? "");

      if (data.complemento) {
        setComplement(data.complemento);
      }

      setMessage("EndereÃ§o localizado automaticamente pelo CEP.");
    } catch {
      setError(
        "NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel consultar o CEP. Confira o nÃºmero ou preencha o endereÃ§o manualmente.",
      );
    } finally {
      setLoadingCep(false);
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    const cleanCep = cep.replace(/\D/g, "");

    if (cleanCep.length === 8) {
      const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
        searchCep(cep);
      }, 400);

      return () => clearTimeout(timeout);
    }
  }, [cep]);

  async function handleSubmit(
    event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>,
  ) {
    event.preventDefault();

    setError("");
    setMessage("");

    const cleanCep = cep.replace(/\D/g, "");
    const normalizedStreet = street.trim();
    const normalizedNumber = number.trim();
    const normalizedNeighborhood = neighborhood.trim();
    const normalizedCity = city.trim();
    const normalizedState = state.trim().toUpperCase();

    if (cleanCep.length !== 8) {
      setError("Informe um CEP vÃ¡lido.");
      return;
    }

    if (!normalizedStreet) {
      setError("Informe o logradouro.");
      return;
    }

    if (!normalizedNumber) {
      setError("Informe o nÃºmero.");
      return;
    }

    if (!normalizedNeighborhood) {
      setError("Informe o bairro.");
      return;
    }

    if (!normalizedCity) {
      setError("Informe a cidade.");
      return;
    }

    if (!normalizedState) {
      setError("Informe o estado.");
      return;
    }

    const radius = Number(serviceRadius);

    if (!Number.isFinite(radius) || radius <= 0) {
      setError("Informe uma Ã¡rea de atendimento vÃ¡lida.");
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const {
        data: { user },
        error: userError,
      } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

      if (userError || !user) {
        setError(
          "Sua sessÃ£o nÃ£o foi encontrada. FaÃ§a login novamente.",
        );
        return;
      }

      /*
       * Verifica se jÃ¡ existe um endereÃ§o padrÃ£o.
       * Se existir, atualizamos.
       * Se nÃ£o existir, criamos.
       */
      const { data: existingAddress, error: existingError } =
        await supabase
          .from("addresses")
          .select("id")
          .eq("profile_id", user.id)
          .eq("is_default", true)
          .maybeSingle();

      if (existingError) {
        throw new Error(existingError.message);
      }

      const addressData = {
        profile_id: user.id,
        label: "EndereÃ§o profissional",
        postal_code: cleanCep,
        street: normalizedStreet,
        number: normalizedNumber,
        complement: complement.trim() || null,
        neighborhood: normalizedNeighborhood,
        city: normalizedCity,
        state: normalizedState,
        country,
        is_default: true,
      };

      let addressError = null;

      if (existingAddress) {
        const result = await supabase
          .from("addresses")
          .update(addressData)
          .eq("id", existingAddress.id);

        addressError = result.error;
      } else {
        const result = await supabase
          .from("addresses")
          .insert(addressData);

        addressError = result.error;
      }

      if (addressError) {
        throw new Error(addressError.message);
      }

      /*
       * A Ã¡rea de atendimento serÃ¡ utilizada na etapa
       * de regiÃµes do profissional.
       *
       * Neste momento salvamos o endereÃ§o corretamente
       * e seguimos para a prÃ³xima etapa.
       */
      console.log("Ãrea de atendimento informada:", radius);

      router.push("/cadastro-profissional/foto");
    } catch (saveError) {
      const errorMessage =
        saveError instanceof Error
          ? saveError.message
          : "Erro desconhecido.";

      setError(
        `NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel salvar o endereÃ§o: ${errorMessage}`,
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-black px-6 py-10 text-white">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-md">
        <div className="mb-8 text-center">
          <div className="mb-4 inline-flex rounded-full border border-orange-500/40 bg-orange-500/10 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-orange-400">
            Etapa 2 de 9
          </div>

          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold">
            Seu endereÃ§o
          </h1>

          <p className="mt-3 text-zinc-400">
            Informe onde vocÃª atende e qual regiÃ£o deseja
            atender pela VemGO.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="mb-7 grid grid-cols-7 gap-1">
          <div className="h-1.5 rounded-full bg-orange-500" />
          <div className="h-1.5 rounded-full bg-orange-500" />
          <div className="h-1.5 rounded-full bg-zinc-800" />
          <div className="h-1.5 rounded-full bg-zinc-800" />
          <div className="h-1.5 rounded-full bg-zinc-800" />
          <div className="h-1.5 rounded-full bg-zinc-800" />
          <div className="h-1.5 rounded-full bg-zinc-800" />
        </div>

        <form
          onSubmit={handleSubmit}
          className="rounded-2xl border border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-950 p-6"
        >
          <div>
            <label
              htmlFor="cep"
              className="text-sm font-medium text-zinc-200"
            >
              CEP
            </label>

            <input
              id="cep"
              type="text"
              inputMode="numeric"
              autoComplete="postal-code"
              value={cep}
              onChange={(event) => {
                setCep(formatCep(event.target.value));
                setError("");
                setMessage("");
              }}
              onBlur={() => searchCep(cep)}
              placeholder="00000-000"
              maxLength={9}
              required
              className="mt-2 w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-900 px-4 py-3 text-white outline-none transition focus:border-orange-500"
            />

            {loadingCep && (

"use client";

import Image from "next/image";
import { ChangeEvent, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { createSupabaseBrowserClient } from "@/lib/supabase-browser";

const MAX_FILE_SIZE = 5 * 1024 * 1024;

const ALLOWED_TYPES = [
  "image/jpeg",
  "image/png",
  "image/webp",
];

export default function CadastroProfissionalFotoPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const supabase = createSupabaseBrowserClient();

  const [userId, setUserId] = useState("");
  const [previewUrl, setPreviewUrl] = useState("");
  const [selectedFile, setSelectedFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [currentAvatarUrl, setCurrentAvatarUrl] = useState("");

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    async function loadProfile() {
      setLoading(true);
      setError("");

      const {
        data: { user },
        error: userError,
      } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

      if (userError || !user) {
        router.replace("/login");
        return;
      }

      setUserId(user.id);

      const { data: profile, error: profileError } =
        await supabase
          .from("profiles")
          .select("avatar_url")
          .eq("id", user.id)
          .maybeSingle();

      if (profileError) {
        setError(
          "NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel carregar os dados do seu perfil.",
        );
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      if (profile?.avatar_url) {
        setCurrentAvatarUrl(profile.avatar_url);
      }

      setLoading(false);
    }

    void loadProfile();
  }, [router, supabase]);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (previewUrl) {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl);
      }
    };
  }, [previewUrl]);

  function handleFileChange(
    event: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>,
  ) {
    setError("");
    setMessage("");

    const file = event.target.files?.[0];

    if (!file) {
      return;
    }

    if (!ALLOWED_TYPES.includes(file.type)) {
      setError(
        "Escolha uma imagem JPG, PNG ou WEBP.",
      );
      event.target.value = "";
      return;
    }

    if (file.size > MAX_FILE_SIZE) {
      setError(
        "A foto precisa ter no mÃ¡ximo 5 MB.",
      );
      event.target.value = "";
      return;
    }

    if (previewUrl) {
      URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl);
    }

    const newPreviewUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);

    setSelectedFile(file);
    setPreviewUrl(newPreviewUrl);
  }

  async function handleUpload() {
    if (!userId) {
      setError("UsuÃ¡rio nÃ£o identificado.");
      return;
    }

    if (!selectedFile) {
      setError("Selecione uma foto para continuar.");
      return;
    }

    setUploading(true);
    setError("");
    setMessage("");

    const fileExtension =
      selectedFile.name.split(".").pop()?.toLowerCase() ||
      "jpg";

    const filePath = `${userId}/profile.${fileExtension}`;

    const { error: uploadError } =
      await supabase.storage
        .from("profile-photos")
        .upload(filePath, selectedFile, {
          cacheControl: "3600",
          upsert: true,
          contentType: selectedFile.type,
        });

    if (uploadError) {
      setError(
        `NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel enviar a foto: ${uploadError.message}`,
      );
      setUploading(false);
      return;
    }

    const { error: avatarError } =
      await supabase.rpc(
        "set_profile_avatar_url",
        {
          p_avatar_url: filePath,
        },
      );

    if (avatarError) {
      await supabase.storage
        .from("profile-photos")
        .remove([filePath]);

      setError(
        `A foto foi enviada, mas nÃ£o foi possÃ­vel atualizar o perfil: ${avatarError.message}`,
      );
      setUploading(false);
      return;
    }

    setCurrentAvatarUrl(filePath);
    setMessage("Foto salva com sucesso.");
    setUploading(false);

    setTimeout(() => {
      router.push("/cadastro-profissional/identidade");
    }, 800);
  }

  function handleSkip() {
    setError(
      "A foto de perfil Ã© obrigatÃ³ria para continuar.",
    );
  }

  function getDisplayImage() {
    if (previewUrl) {
      return previewUrl;
    }

    return "";
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-zinc-950 px-6 py-10 text-white">
      <div className="mx-auto flex min-h-[85vh] max-w-md flex-col justify-center">
        <div className="mb-8 text-center">
          <Image
            src="/logo-vemgo.png"
            alt="VemGO"
            width={360}
            height={200}
            className="mx-auto h-auto w-[190px] object-contain"
            priority
          />

          <p className="mt-6 text-sm font-medium text-orange-400">
            Etapa 3 de 9
          </p>

          <div className="mx-auto mt-3 flex max-w-xs gap-1.5">
            {Array.from({ length: 7 }).map((_, index) => (
              <div
                key={index}
                className={`h-1.5 flex-1 rounded-full ${
                  index < 3
                    ? "bg-orange-500"
                    : "bg-zinc-800"
                }`}
              />
            ))}
          </div>

          <h1 className="mt-8 text-3xl font-bold">
            Sua foto de perfil
          </h1>

          <p className="mt-3 text-sm leading-6 text-zinc-400">
            Use uma foto recente e nÃ­tida. Ela serÃ¡ utilizada
            para identificar seu perfil profissional na VemGO.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-zinc-800 bg-black p-6 shadow-sm">
          {loading ? (
            <div className="py-12 text-center text-sm text-zinc-400">
              Carregando seu perfil...
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              <div className="flex justify-center">
                <div className="flex h-40 w-40 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-full border-2 border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-900">
                  {getDisplayImage() ? (
                    // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
                    <img
                      src={getDisplayImage()}
                      alt="PrÃ©-visualizaÃ§Ã£o da foto de perfil"
                      className="h-full w-full object-cover"
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <div className="px-5 text-center text-sm text-zinc-500">
                      Sua foto aparecerÃ¡ aqui
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              {currentAvatarUrl && !previewUrl && (
                <p className="mt-4 text-center text-xs text-zinc-500">
                  VocÃª jÃ¡ possui uma foto cadastrada. Selecione
                  outra para substituÃ­-la.
                </p>
              )}

              <label
                htmlFor="profile-photo"
                className="mt-6 flex cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-900 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition hover:border-orange-500 hover:bg-zinc-800"
              >
                Escolher foto

              <input
                id="profile-photo"

"use client";

import Image from "next/image";
import {
  ChangeEvent,
  useEffect,
  useState,
} from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { createSupabaseBrowserClient } from "@/lib/supabase-browser";
import { OnboardingStepper } from "@/components/vemgo/OnboardingStepper";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";

type DocumentType = "rg" | "cnh" | "passport";

const DOCUMENT_TYPES: {
  value: DocumentType;
  label: string;
}[] = [
  {
    value: "rg",
    label: "RG",
  },
  {
    value: "cnh",
    label: "CPF / CNH",
  },
  {
    value: "passport",
    label: "Passaporte",
  },
];

const MAX_FILE_SIZE = 8 * 1024 * 1024;

const ALLOWED_TYPES = [
  "image/jpeg",
  "image/png",
  "image/webp",
];

export default function CadastroProfissionalIdentidadePage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const supabase = createSupabaseBrowserClient();

  const [userId, setUserId] = useState("");

  const [documentType, setDocumentType] =
    useState<DocumentType>("cnh");

  const [documentNumber, setDocumentNumber] =
    useState("");

  const [frontFile, setFrontFile] =
    useState<File | null>(null);

  const [backFile, setBackFile] =
    useState<File | null>(null);

  const [selfieFile, setSelfieFile] =
    useState<File | null>(null);

  const [frontPreview, setFrontPreview] =
    useState("");

  const [backPreview, setBackPreview] =
    useState("");

  const [selfiePreview, setSelfiePreview] =
    useState("");

  const [existingStatus, setExistingStatus] =
    useState("");

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] =
    useState(false);

  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    async function loadIdentity() {
      setLoading(true);
      setError("");

      const {
        data: { user },
        error: userError,
      } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

      if (cancelled) return;

      if (userError || !user) {
        router.replace("/login");
        return;
      }

      setUserId(user.id);

      const { data: verification } = await supabase
        .from("identity_verifications")
        .select("status")
        .eq("profile_id", user.id)
        .order("created_at", {
          ascending: false,
        })
        .limit(1)
        .maybeSingle();

      if (cancelled) return;

      if (verification?.status) {
        setExistingStatus(verification.status);
      }

      setLoading(false);
    }

    void loadIdentity();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [router, supabase]);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (frontPreview) {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(frontPreview);
      }

      if (backPreview) {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(backPreview);
      }

      if (selfiePreview) {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(selfiePreview);
      }
    };
  }, [
    frontPreview,
    backPreview,
    selfiePreview,
  ]);

  function validateImage(file: File) {
    if (!ALLOWED_TYPES.includes(file.type)) {
      return "Escolha uma imagem JPG, PNG ou WEBP.";
    }

    if (file.size > MAX_FILE_SIZE) {
      return "A imagem precisa ter no mÃ¡ximo 8 MB.";
    }

    return "";
  }

  function handleImageChange(
    event: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>,
    type: "front" | "back" | "selfie",
  ) {
    setError("");
    setMessage("");

    const file = event.target.files?.[0];

    if (!file) {
      return;
    }

    const validationError =
      validateImage(file);

    if (validationError) {
      setError(validationError);
      event.target.value = "";
      return;
    }

    const preview =
      URL.createObjectURL(file);

    if (type === "front") {
      if (frontPreview) {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(frontPreview);
      }

      setFrontFile(file);
      setFrontPreview(preview);
    }

    if (type === "back") {
      if (backPreview) {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(backPreview);
      }

      setBackFile(file);
      setBackPreview(preview);
    }

    if (type === "selfie") {
      if (selfiePreview) {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(selfiePreview);
      }

      setSelfieFile(file);
      setSelfiePreview(preview);
    }
  }

  function sanitizeDocumentNumber(
    value: string,
  ) {
    return value.trim();
  }

  async function uploadFile(
    file: File,
    path: string,
  ) {
    const { error: uploadError } =
      await supabase.storage
        .from("identity-documents")
        .upload(path, file, {
          cacheControl: "3600",
          upsert: true,
          contentType: file.type,
        });

    if (uploadError) {
      throw new Error(uploadError.message);
    }
  }

  async function advanceOnboarding() {
    if (!userId) {
      throw new Error(
        "UsuÃ¡rio nÃ£o identificado.",
      );
    }

    const { error: onboardingError } =
      await supabase
        .from("profiles")
        .update({
          professional_onboarding_step: 5,
        })
        .eq("id", userId);

    if (onboardingError) {
      throw new Error(
        `NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel atualizar o progresso do cadastro: ${onboardingError.message}`,
      );
    }
  }

  async function handleSubmit() {
    setError("");
    setMessage("");

    const normalizedNumber =
      sanitizeDocumentNumber(
        documentNumber,
      );

    if (!normalizedNumber) {
      setError(
        "Informe o nÃºmero do documento.",
      );
      return;
    }

    if (!frontFile) {
      setError(
        "Envie a foto da frente do documento.",
      );
      return;
    }

    if (
      documentType !== "passport" &&
      !backFile
    ) {
      setError(
        "Envie tambÃ©m a foto do verso do documento.",
      );
      return;
    }

    if (!selfieFile) {
      setError(
        "Envie uma selfie para continuar.",
      );
      return;
    }

    if (!userId) {
      setError(
        "UsuÃ¡rio nÃ£o identificado.",
      );
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);

    let frontPath = "";
    let backPath = "";
    let selfiePath = "";

    try {
      const timestamp = Date.now();

      const frontExtension =
        frontFile.name
          .split(".")
          .pop()
          ?.toLowerCase() || "jpg";

      const selfieExtension =
        selfieFile.name
          .split(".")
          .pop()
          ?.toLowerCase() || "jpg";

      frontPath =
        `${userId}/identity/front-${timestamp}.${frontExtension}`;

      selfiePath =
        `${userId}/identity/selfie-${timestamp}.${selfieExtension}`;

      if (documentType !== "passport") {
        const backExtension =
          backFile?.name
            .split(".")
            .pop()
            ?.toLowerCase() || "jpg";

        backPath =
          `${userId}/identity/back-${timestamp}.${backExtension}`;
      }

      await uploadFile(
        frontFile,
        frontPath,
      );

      if (
        documentType !== "passport" &&
        backFile &&
        backPath
      ) {
        await uploadFile(
          backFile,
          backPath,
        );
      }

      await uploadFile(
        selfieFile,
        selfiePath,
      );

      const {
        data: document,
        error: documentError,
      } = await supabase
        .from("identity_documents")
        .insert({
          profile_id: userId,
          document_type: documentType,
          document_number: normalizedNumber,
          document_front_path: frontPath,
          document_back_path:
            backPath || null,
          verification_status: "pending",
        })
        .select("id")
        .single();

      if (
        documentError ||
        !document
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          documentError?.message ||
            "NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel registrar o documento.",
        );
      }

      const {
        error: verificationError,
      } = await supabase
        .from("identity_verifications")
        .insert({
          profile_id: userId,
          identity_document_id:
            document.id,
          verification_type:
            "full_identity",
          status: "pending",
          selfie_path: selfiePath,
        });

      if (verificationError) {
        await supabase.storage
          .from("identity-documents")
          .remove(
            [
              frontPath,
              ...(backPath
                ? [backPath]
                : []),
              selfiePath,
            ],
          );

        throw new Error(
          verificationError.message,
        );
      }

      await advanceOnboarding();

      setMessage(
        "Documentos enviados. Sua identidade estÃ¡ aguardando validaÃ§Ã£o.",
      );

      setTimeout(() => {
        router.push(
          "/cadastro-profissional/competencias",
        );
      }, 900);
    } catch (submitError) {
      const errorMessage =
        submitError instanceof Error
          ? submitError.message

"use client";

import Image from "next/image";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { createSupabaseBrowserClient } from "@/lib/supabase-browser";

function formatCPF(value: string) {
  const numbers = value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 11);

  if (numbers.length <= 3) return numbers;
  if (numbers.length <= 6) {
    return `${numbers.slice(0, 3)}.${numbers.slice(3)}`;
  }
  if (numbers.length <= 9) {
    return `${numbers.slice(0, 3)}.${numbers.slice(3, 6)}.${numbers.slice(6)}`;
  }

  return `${numbers.slice(0, 3)}.${numbers.slice(3, 6)}.${numbers.slice(
    6,
    9,
  )}-${numbers.slice(9)}`;
}

function formatPhone(value: string) {
  const numbers = value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 11);

  if (numbers.length <= 2) return numbers;
  if (numbers.length <= 7) {
    return `(${numbers.slice(0, 2)}) ${numbers.slice(2)}`;
  }

  return `(${numbers.slice(0, 2)}) ${numbers.slice(2, 7)}-${numbers.slice(
    7,
  )}`;
}

function isValidCPF(value: string) {
  const cpf = value.replace(/\D/g, "");

  if (cpf.length !== 11) return false;

  if (/^(\d)\1+$/.test(cpf)) return false;

  let sum = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
    sum += Number(cpf[i]) * (10 - i);
  }

  let remainder = (sum * 10) % 11;

  if (remainder === 10) remainder = 0;

  if (remainder !== Number(cpf[9])) return false;

  sum = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
    sum += Number(cpf[i]) * (11 - i);
  }

  remainder = (sum * 10) % 11;

  if (remainder === 10) remainder = 0;

  return remainder === Number(cpf[10]);
}

type ProfessionalService = {
  service_id: string;
  code: string;
  name: string;
  price: number | null;
};

export default function CadastroProfissionalPrecosPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const supabase = createSupabaseBrowserClient();

  const [services, setServices] = useState<ProfessionalService[]>([]);
  const [prices, setPrices] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    async function loadData() {
      setLoading(true);
      setError("");

      const {
        data: { user },
        error: userError,
      } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

      if (userError || !user) {
        router.replace("/login");
        return;
      }

      const { data: profile, error: profileError } =
        await supabase
          .from("profiles")
          .select("user_type")
          .eq("id", user.id)
          .maybeSingle();

      if (
        profileError ||
        !profile ||
        profile.user_type !== "professional"
      ) {
        router.replace("/login");
        return;
      }

      const {
        data: professionalServices,
        error: servicesError,
      } = await supabase
        .from("professional_services")
        .select(`
          service_id,
          services (
            code,
            name
          )
        `)
        .eq("professional_id", user.id)
        .eq("is_active", true);

      if (servicesError) {
        setError(
          `NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel carregar suas competÃªncias: ${servicesError.message}`,
        );
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      const {
        data: existingPrices,
        error: pricesError,
      } = await supabase
        .from("service_prices")
        .select("service_id, price")
        .eq("professional_id", user.id)
        .eq("is_active", true);

      if (pricesError) {
        setError(
          `NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel carregar seus preÃ§os: ${pricesError.message}`,
        );
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      const loadedServices: ProfessionalService[] = (
        professionalServices ?? []
      )
        .map((item) => {
          const service = Array.isArray(item.services)
            ? item.services[0]
            : item.services;

          if (!service) {
            return null;
          }

          const existingPrice = (
            existingPrices ?? []
          ).find(
            (price) => price.service_id === item.service_id,
          );

          return {
            service_id: item.service_id,
            code: service.code,
            name: service.name,
            price: existingPrice?.price ?? null,
          };
        })
        .filter(
          (item): item is ProfessionalService =>
            item !== null,
        )
        .sort((a, b) =>
          a.code.localeCompare(b.code),
        );

      if (loadedServices.length === 0) {
        setError(
          "Nenhum serviÃ§o foi encontrado. Volte para competÃªncias e selecione pelo menos um serviÃ§o.",
        );
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      const initialPrices: Record<string, string> = {};

      for (const service of loadedServices) {
        initialPrices[service.service_id] =
          service.price !== null
            ? service.price
                .toFixed(2)
                .replace(".", ",")
            : "";
      }

      setServices(loadedServices);
      setPrices(initialPrices);
      setLoading(false);
    }

    void loadData();
  }, [router, supabase]);

  function handlePriceChange(
    serviceId: string,
    value: string,
  ) {
    setError("");
    setMessage("");

    let normalized = value.replace(/[^\d,]/g, "");

    const firstComma = normalized.indexOf(",");

    if (firstComma !== -1) {
      normalized =
        normalized.slice(0, firstComma + 1) +
        normalized
          .slice(firstComma + 1)
          .replace(/,/g, "");
    }

    if (normalized.includes(",")) {
      const [integerPart, decimalPart] =
        normalized.split(",");

      normalized =
        integerPart +
        "," +
        decimalPart.slice(0, 2);
    }

    setPrices((current) => ({
      ...current,
      [serviceId]: normalized,
    }));
  }

  function parsePrice(value: string) {
    return Number(
      value
        .replace(/\./g, "")
        .replace(",", "."),
    );
  }

  async function handleSave(

  ) {

    const rows = services.map((service) => ({

      );
      setSaving(false);

"use client";

import Image from "next/image";
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useParams, useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { createSupabaseBrowserClient } from "@/lib/supabase-browser";

type Order = {
  id: string;
  client_id: string;
  professional_id: string;
  service_id: string;
  address_id: string;
  price: number;
  currency: string;
  status: string;
  scheduled_start: string | null;
  scheduled_end: string | null;
};

type Appointment = {
  id: string;
  order_id: string;
  professional_id: string;
  starts_at: string;
  ends_at: string;
  status:
    | "scheduled"
    | "confirmed"
    | "cancelled"
    | "in_progress"
    | "completed"
    | "no_show";
  confirmed_at: string | null;
  cancelled_at: string | null;
  cancellation_reason: string | null;
};

type Availability = {
  id: string;
  day_of_week: number;
  start_time: string;
  end_time: string;
  is_active: boolean;
};

type ScheduleData = {
  order_id: string;
  professional_id: string;
  availability: Availability[];
  appointments: Appointment[];
};

type SupabaseError = {
  message?: string;
};

const supabase = createSupabaseBrowserClient();

function getErrorMessage(error: unknown, fallback: string) {
  if (
    typeof error === "object" &&
    error !== null &&
    "message" in error
  ) {
    const message = (error as SupabaseError).message;

    if (typeof message === "string" && message.length > 0) {
      return message;
    }
  }

  return fallback;
}

function formatCurrency(value: number) {
  return value.toLocaleString("pt-BR", {
    style: "currency",
    currency: "BRL",
  });
}

function formatDate(date: Date) {
  return date.toLocaleDateString("pt-BR", {
    weekday: "long",
    day: "2-digit",
    month: "2-digit",
    year: "numeric",
  });
}

function formatDateShort(date: Date) {
  return date.toLocaleDateString("pt-BR", {
    day: "2-digit",
    month: "2-digit",
  });
}

function formatTime(date: Date) {
  return date.toLocaleTimeString("pt-BR", {
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
  });
}

function getLocalDateKey(date: Date) {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
  const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");

  return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
}

function createLocalDate(dateKey: string, hour: number) {
  const [year, month, day] = dateKey.split("-").map(Number);

  return new Date(year, month - 1, day, hour, 0, 0, 0);
}

function timeToMinutes(time: string) {
  const [hours, minutes] = time.slice(0, 5).split(":").map(Number);

  return hours * 60 + minutes;
}

function getDayOfWeek(date: Date) {
  return date.getDay();
}

function isSameHour(dateA: Date, dateB: Date) {
  return (
    dateA.getFullYear() === dateB.getFullYear() &&
    dateA.getMonth() === dateB.getMonth() &&
    dateA.getDate() === dateB.getDate() &&
    dateA.getHours() === dateB.getHours()
  );
}

export default function ClienteAgendamentoPage() {
  const params = useParams();
  const router = useRouter();

  const orderId = params.orderId as string;

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const [order, setOrder] = useState<Order | null>(null);
  const [appointment, setAppointment] =
    useState<Appointment | null>(null);
  const [schedule, setSchedule] =
    useState<ScheduleData | null>(null);

  const [selectedDate, setSelectedDate] =
    useState<Date | null>(null);
  const [selectedTime, setSelectedTime] =
    useState<Date | null>(null);

  const [isRescheduling, setIsRescheduling] =
    useState(false);

  const today = useMemo(() => {
    const date = new Date();

    date.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

    return date;
  }, []);

  const calendarDays = useMemo(() => {
    const days: Date[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
      const date = new Date(today);

      date.setDate(today.getDate() + i);

      days.push(date);
    }

    return days;
  }, [today]);

  function hasAvailableSlot(
    date: Date,
    scheduleData: ScheduleData | null
  ) {
    if (!scheduleData) {
      return false;
    }

    const dayOfWeek = getDayOfWeek(date);

    const availability =
      scheduleData.availability.filter(
        (item) =>
          item.is_active &&
          item.day_of_week === dayOfWeek
      );

    if (availability.length === 0) {
      return false;
    }

    const appointments =
      scheduleData.appointments || [];

    for (const window of availability) {
      const startMinutes = timeToMinutes(
        window.start_time
      );

      const endMinutes = timeToMinutes(
        window.end_time
      );

      for (
        let minutes = startMinutes;
        minutes + 60 <= endMinutes;
        minutes += 60
      ) {
        const hour = Math.floor(minutes / 60);

        const slotStart = createLocalDate(
          getLocalDateKey(date),
          hour
        );

        const slotEnd = new Date(slotStart);

        slotEnd.setHours(
          slotStart.getHours() + 1
        );

        const occupied = appointments.some((item) => {
          if (
            ![
              "scheduled",
              "confirmed",
              "in_progress",
            ].includes(item.status)
          ) {
            return false;
          }

          const appointmentStart =
            new Date(item.starts_at);

          const appointmentEnd =
            new Date(item.ends_at);

          return (
            appointmentStart < slotEnd &&
            appointmentEnd > slotStart
          );
        });

        if (!occupied) {
          return true;
        }
      }
    }

    return false;
  }

  function getAvailableTimes(date: Date) {
    if (!schedule) {
      return [];
    }

    const dayOfWeek = getDayOfWeek(date);

    const availability =
      schedule.availability.filter(
        (item) =>
          item.is_active &&
          item.day_of_week === dayOfWeek
      );

    const appointments =
      schedule.appointments || [];

    const times: Date[] = [];

    for (const window of availability) {
      const startMinutes = timeToMinutes(
        window.start_time
      );

      const endMinutes = timeToMinutes(
        window.end_time
      );

      for (
        let minutes = startMinutes;
        minutes + 60 <= endMinutes;
        minutes += 60
      ) {
        const hour = Math.floor(minutes / 60);

        const slotStart = createLocalDate(
          getLocalDateKey(date),
          hour
        );

        const slotEnd = new Date(slotStart);

        slotEnd.setHours(
          slotStart.getHours() + 1
        );

        const occupied = appointments.some((item) => {
          if (
            ![
              "scheduled",
              "confirmed",
              "in_progress",
            ].includes(item.status)
          ) {
            return false;
          }

          const appointmentStart =
            new Date(item.starts_at);

          const appointmentEnd =
            new Date(item.ends_at);

          return (
            appointmentStart < slotEnd &&
            appointmentEnd > slotStart
          );
        });

        if (!occupied) {
          times.push(slotStart);
        }
      }
    }

    return times;
  }

  async function loadPage() {
    setLoading(true);
    setError("");

    try {
      const {
        data: { user },
      } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

      if (!user) {
        router.replace("/login");
        return;
      }

      const { data: profile, error: profileError } =
        await supabase
          .from("profiles")
          .select("id,user_type,status")
          .eq("id", user.id)
          .single();

      if (profileError) {
        throw profileError;
      }

      if (profile?.user_type !== "client") {
        router.replace("/login");
        return;
      }

      const { data: orderData, error: orderError } =
        await supabase
          .from("orders")
          .select(
            `
              id,
              client_id,
              professional_id,
              service_id,
              address_id,
              price,
              currency,
              status,
              scheduled_start,
              scheduled_end
            `
          )
          .eq("id", orderId)
          .eq("client_id", user.id)
          .single();

      if (orderError) {
        throw orderError;
      }

      setOrder(orderData);

      const {
        data: scheduleData,
        error: scheduleError,
      } = await supabase.rpc(
        "get_client_order_schedule",
        {
          p_order_id: orderId,
        }
      );

      if (scheduleError) {
        throw scheduleError;
      }

      const normalizedSchedule =
        scheduleData as ScheduleData;

      setSchedule(normalizedSchedule);

      const appointments = [
        ...(normalizedSchedule.appointments || []),
      ].sort(
        (a, b) =>
          new Date(a.starts_at).getTime() -
          new Date(b.starts_at).getTime()
      );

      const currentAppointment =
        appointments.find(
          (item) =>
            item.order_id === orderId &&
            [
              "scheduled",
              "confirmed",
              "in_progress",
            ].includes(item.status)
        );

      setAppointment(
        currentAppointment || null
      );

      if (!currentAppointment) {
        const firstAvailable =
          calendarDays.find((date) =>
            hasAvailableSlot(
              date,
              normalizedSchedule
            )
          );

        if (firstAvailable) {
          setSelectedDate(firstAvailable);
        }
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      console.error(err);

      setError(
        getErrorMessage(
          err,
          "NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel carregar o agendamento."
        )
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  async function handleRequestTime() {
    if (
      !selectedDate ||
      !selectedTime ||
      !order
    ) {
      return;
    }

    setSaving(true);
    setError("");
    setMessage("");

    try {
      const start = new Date(selectedTime);

      const end = new Date(start);

      end.setHours(
        end.getHours() + 1
      );

      let data;

      if (isRescheduling) {

            p_order_id: order.id,

            p_starts_at: start.toISOString(),

  }

  function startRescheduling() {
    setError("");
    setMessage("");
    setSelectedTime(null);
    setIsRescheduling(true);

      calendarDays.find((date) =>
        hasAvailableSlot(date, schedule)

  }

  function cancelRescheduling() {
    setIsRescheduling(false);
    setSelectedTime(null);

    setMessage("");
  }

  /*

  }

  }

  const appointmentStart =
    appointment
      ? new Date(appointment.starts_at)
      : null;

  const appointmentEnd =
    appointment
      ? new Date(appointment.ends_at)
      : null;

  const availableTimes =
    selectedDate
      ? getAvailableTimes(selectedDate)
      : [];

  const showPending =
    appointment?.status === "scheduled" &&
    !isRescheduling;

  const showConfirmed =
    appointment?.status === "confirmed" &&
    !isRescheduling;

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-black text-white">
      <header className="border-b border-zinc-800 bg-black">
        <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-6xl items-center justify-between px-6 py-4">

              priority
            />
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() =>

            }
            className="text-sm text-zinc-400 hover:text-white"
          >
            â† Meus serviÃ§os

        </div>
      </header>

      <section className="mx-auto max-w-5xl px-6 py-10">

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import Image from "next/image";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { createSupabaseBrowserClient } from "@/lib/supabase-browser";

export default function NovoEnderecoPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const supabase = createSupabaseBrowserClient();

  const [label, setLabel] = useState("Principal");
  const [recipientName, setRecipientName] = useState("");
  const [postalCode, setPostalCode] = useState("");
  const [street, setStreet] = useState("");
  const [number, setNumber] = useState("");
  const [complement, setComplement] = useState("");
  const [neighborhood, setNeighborhood] = useState("");
  const [city, setCity] = useState("");
  const [state, setState] = useState("");
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [loadingCep, setLoadingCep] = useState(false);

  function handlePostalCodeChange(value: string) {
    const cep = value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 8);

    if (cep.length > 5) {
      setPostalCode(`${cep.slice(0, 5)}-${cep.slice(5)}`);
    } else {
      setPostalCode(cep);
    }
  }

  async function handleCepBlur() {
    const cep = postalCode.replace(/\D/g, "");

    if (cep.length !== 8) {
      return;
    }

    setMessage("");
    setLoadingCep(true);

    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `https://viacep.com.br/ws/${cep}/json/`
      );

      if (!response.ok) {
        setMessage("NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel consultar o CEP.");
        return;
      }

      const data = await response.json();

      if (data.erro) {
        setMessage("CEP nÃ£o encontrado.");
        return;
      }

      setStreet(data.logradouro || "");
      setNeighborhood(data.bairro || "");
      setCity(data.localidade || "");
      setState(data.uf || "");
    } catch {
      setMessage("NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel consultar o CEP.");
    } finally {
      setLoadingCep(false);
    }
  }

  async function handleSave() {
    setMessage("");

    const {
      data: { user },
    } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

    if (!user) {
      router.replace("/login");
      return;
    }

    if (
      !street.trim() ||
      !number.trim() ||
      !neighborhood.trim() ||
      !city.trim() ||
      !state.trim()
    ) {
      setMessage("Preencha os campos obrigatÃ³rios.");
      return;
    }

    const { count, error: countError } = await supabase
      .from("addresses")
      .select("id", { count: "exact", head: true })
      .eq("profile_id", user.id);

    if (countError) {
      setMessage(`Erro: ${countError.message}`);
      return;
    }

    const isFirstAddress = (count ?? 0) === 0;

    const { error } = await supabase.from("addresses").insert({
      profile_id: user.id,
      label: label.trim() || "Principal",
      recipient_name: recipientName.trim() || null,
      postal_code: postalCode.trim() || null,
      street: street.trim(),
      number: number.trim(),
      complement: complement.trim() || null,
      neighborhood: neighborhood.trim(),
      city: city.trim(),
      state: state.trim().toUpperCase(),
      country: "BR",
      is_default: isFirstAddress,
    });

    if (error) {
      setMessage(`Erro: ${error.message}`);
      return;
    }

    router.push("/cliente/enderecos");
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-zinc-50">
      <header className="border-b border-zinc-200 bg-black">
        <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-4xl items-center justify-between px-6 py-4">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => router.push("/cliente/enderecos")}
            className="flex items-center"
          >
            <Image
              src="/logo-vemgo.png"
              alt="VemGO"
              width={150}
              height={55}
              priority
              className="h-auto w-[150px] object-contain"
            />
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => router.push("/cliente/enderecos")}
            className="rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 bg-white px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-700 hover:bg-zinc-100"
          >
            Voltar
          </button>
        </div>
      </header>

      <section className="mx-auto max-w-2xl px-6 py-10">
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-8 shadow-sm">
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-zinc-900">
            Cadastrar endereÃ§o
          </h2>

          <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-zinc-500">
            Informe o local onde o serviÃ§o serÃ¡ realizado.
          </p>

          <div className="mt-8 space-y-5">
            <div>
              <label className="mb-2 block text-sm font-medium text-zinc-700">
                Nome do endereÃ§o
              </label>

              <input
                type="text"
                value={label}
                onChange={(event) => setLabel(event.target.value)}
                placeholder="Ex.: Casa"
                className="h-12 w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-300 px-4 outline-none focus:border-emerald-600 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-100"
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="mb-2 block text-sm font-medium text-zinc-700">
                Nome de quem recebe
              </label>

              <input
                type="text"
                value={recipientName}
                onChange={(event) => setRecipientName(event.target.value)}
                placeholder="Nome completo"
                className="h-12 w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-300 px-4 outline-none focus:border-emerald-600 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-100"
              />
            </div>

                  onChange={(event) => setCity(event.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Cidade"
                  className="h-12 w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-300 px-4 outline-none focus:border-emerald-600 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-100"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="mb-2 block text-sm font-medium text-zinc-700">
                  Estado
                </label>

                <input
                  type="text"
                  maxLength={2}
                  value={state}
                  onChange={(event) => setState(event.target.value)}
                  placeholder="SP"
                  className="h-12 w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-300 px-4 uppercase outline-none focus:border-emerald-600 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-100"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleSave}
              className="h-12 w-full rounded-xl bg-emerald-700 font-semibold text-white hover:bg-emerald-800"
            >
              Salvar endereÃ§o
            </button>

            {message && (
              <div className="rounded-xl bg-red-50 px-4 py-3 text-center text-sm text-red-700">
                {message}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>
    </main>
