"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Image from "next/image";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { createSupabaseBrowserClient } from "@/lib/supabase-browser";

type Address = {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  recipient_name: string | null;
  postal_code: string | null;
  street: string;
  number: string;
  complement: string | null;
  neighborhood: string;
  city: string;
  state: string;
  country: string;
  is_default: boolean;
};

export default function EnderecosPage() {
  const router = useRouter();

  const [addresses, setAddresses] = useState<Address[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;

    async function loadAddresses() {
      const supabase = createSupabaseBrowserClient();

      const {
        data: { user },
      } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

      if (!user) {
        router.replace("/login");
        return;
      }

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("addresses")
        .select(
          "id, label, recipient_name, postal_code, street, number, complement, neighborhood, city, state, country, is_default"
        )
        .eq("profile_id", user.id)
        .order("is_default", { ascending: false })
        .order("created_at", { ascending: false });

      if (!active) {
        return;
      }

      if (error) {
        setMessage("NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel carregar seus endereÃ§os.");
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      setAddresses(data || []);
      setLoading(false);
    }

    void Promise.resolve().then(loadAddresses);

    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [router]);

  async function handleSetDefault(addressId: string) {
    setMessage("");
    setSaving(true);

    const supabase = createSupabaseBrowserClient();

    const {
      data: { user },
    } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

    if (!user) {
      router.replace("/login");
      return;
    }

    const { error: resetError } = await supabase
      .from("addresses")
      .update({ is_default: false })
      .eq("profile_id", user.id)
      .eq("is_default", true);

    if (resetError) {
      setMessage("NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel alterar o endereÃ§o principal.");
      setSaving(false);
      return;
    }

    const { error: defaultError } = await supabase
      .from("addresses")
      .update({ is_default: true })
      .eq("id", addressId)
      .eq("profile_id", user.id);

    if (defaultError) {
      setMessage("NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel definir o endereÃ§o principal.");
      setSaving(false);
      return;
    }

    setAddresses((current) =>
      current.map((address) => ({
        ...address,
        is_default: address.id === addressId,
      }))
    );

    setMessage("EndereÃ§o principal atualizado.");
    setSaving(false);
  }

  async function handleDelete(addressId: string) {
    setMessage("");

    const address = addresses.find((item) => item.id === addressId);

    if (!address) {
      return;
    }

    if (address.is_default) {
      setMessage(
        "Defina outro endereÃ§o como principal antes de excluir este."
      );
      return;
    }

    const confirmed = window.confirm(
      "Deseja realmente excluir este endereÃ§o?"
    );

    if (!confirmed) {
      return;
    }

    setSaving(true);

    const supabase = createSupabaseBrowserClient();

    const {
      data: { user },
    } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

    if (!user) {
      router.replace("/login");
      return;
    }

    const { error } = await supabase
      .from("addresses")
      .delete()
      .eq("id", addressId)
      .eq("profile_id", user.id);

    if (error) {
      setMessage("NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel excluir o endereÃ§o.");
      setSaving(false);
      return;
    }

    setAddresses((current) =>
      current.filter((item) => item.id !== addressId)
    );

    setMessage("EndereÃ§o excluÃ­do.");
    setSaving(false);
  }

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <main className="flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center bg-zinc-50">
        <p className="text-sm text-zinc-500">Carregando endereÃ§os...</p>
      </main>
    );
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-zinc-50">
      <header className="border-b border-zinc-200 bg-black">
        <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-5xl items-center justify-between px-6 py-4">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => router.push("/cliente")}
            className="flex items-center"
          >
            <Image
              src="/logo-vemgo.png"
              alt="VemGO"
              width={150}
              height={55}
              priority
              className="h-auto w-[150px] object-contain"
            />
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => router.push("/cliente")}
            className="rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 bg-white px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-700 hover:bg-zinc-100"
          >
            Voltar
          </button>
        </div>
      </header>

      <section className="mx-auto max-w-5xl px-6 py-10">
        <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold text-zinc-900">
              Meus endereÃ§os
            </h2>

            <p className="mt-2 text-zinc-600">
              Cadastre e gerencie os locais onde vocÃª solicita serviÃ§os.
            </p>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => router.push("/cliente/enderecos/novo")}
            className="rounded-xl bg-emerald-700 px-5 py-3 font-semibold text-white hover:bg-emerald-800"
          >
            + Novo endereÃ§o
          </button>
        </div>

        {message && (
          <div className="mt-6 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-emerald-800">
            {message}
          </div>
        )}

        {addresses.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="mt-8 rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-8 text-center shadow-sm">
            <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-zinc-900">
              Nenhum endereÃ§o cadastrado
            </h3>

            <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-zinc-500">
              Cadastre seu primeiro endereÃ§o para solicitar serviÃ§os pela
              VemGO.
            </p>

            <button
              type="button"

        ) : (

"use client";

import Image from "next/image";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { createSupabaseBrowserClient } from "@/lib/supabase-browser";

type Address = {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  recipient_name: string | null;
  street: string;
  number: string;
  complement: string | null;
  neighborhood: string;
  city: string;
  state: string;
  is_default: boolean;
};


export default function ClientePage() {
  const router = useRouter();

  const [name, setName] = useState("Cliente");
  const [description, setDescription] = useState("");
  const [urgency, setUrgency] = useState<"normal" | "urgent">("normal");

  const [addresses, setAddresses] = useState<Address[]>([]);
  const [selectedAddressId, setSelectedAddressId] = useState("");

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    async function loadClient() {
      const supabase = createSupabaseBrowserClient();

      const {
        data: { user },
      } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

      if (!user) {
        router.replace("/login");
        return;
      }

      const { data: profile, error: profileError } = await supabase
        .from("profiles")
        .select("full_name, user_type, status")
        .eq("id", user.id)
        .maybeSingle();

      if (cancelled) {
        return;
      }

      if (
        profileError ||
        !profile ||
        profile.user_type !== "client" ||
        profile.status === "blocked"
      ) {
        router.replace("/login");
        return;
      }

      setName(profile.full_name || "Cliente");

      const { data: addressData, error: addressError } =
        await supabase
          .from("addresses")
          .select(
            "id, label, recipient_name, street, number, complement, neighborhood, city, state, is_default"
          )
          .eq("profile_id", user.id)
          .order("is_default", { ascending: false })
          .order("created_at", { ascending: false });

      if (cancelled) {
        return;
      }

      if (addressError) {
        setError("NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel carregar seus endereÃ§os.");
      } else {
        const loadedAddresses = addressData || [];

        setAddresses(loadedAddresses);

        const defaultAddress =
          loadedAddresses.find((address) => address.is_default) ||
          loadedAddresses[0];

        if (defaultAddress) {
          setSelectedAddressId(defaultAddress.id);
        }
      }

      setLoading(false);
    }

    void loadClient();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [router]);

  async function handleLogout() {
    const supabase = createSupabaseBrowserClient();

    await supabase.auth.signOut();

    router.replace("/login");
  }

  function classifyService(text: string) {
    const normalized = text
      .toLowerCase()
      .normalize("NFD")
      .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "");

    /*
     * Regras iniciais do MVP.
     *
     * A IA entrarÃ¡ futuramente para interpretar necessidades
     * que nÃ£o possam ser resolvidas por regras.
     */

    if (
      normalized.includes("tomada") &&
      (normalized.includes("energia") ||
        normalized.includes("sem energia") ||
        normalized.includes("nao funciona") ||
        normalized.includes("nÃ£o funciona"))
    ) {
      return "ELE-098";
    }

    if (
      normalized.includes("lampada") ||
      normalized.includes("luz") ||
      normalized.includes("lÃ¢mpada") ||
      normalized.includes("iluminacao") ||
      normalized.includes("iluminaÃ§Ã£o")
    ) {
      return "ELE-001";
    }

    return null;
  }

  async function handleRequest() {
    setMessage("");
    setError("");

    const trimmedDescription = description.trim();

    if (!trimmedDescription) {
      setError("Descreva o que vocÃª precisa.");
      return;
    }

    if (!selectedAddressId) {
      setError(
        "Selecione um endereÃ§o ou cadastre um novo endereÃ§o."
      );
      return;
    }

    setSending(true);

    try {
      const supabase = createSupabaseBrowserClient();

      const {
        data: { user },
      } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

      if (!user) {
        router.replace("/login");
        return;
      }

      const serviceCode = classifyService(trimmedDescription);

      if (!serviceCode) {
        setError(
          "Ainda nÃ£o conseguimos identificar automaticamente este serviÃ§o. No MVP atual, experimente descrever uma necessidade de forma mais especÃ­fica."
        );
        return;
      }

      const { data: service, error: serviceError } = await supabase
        .from("services")
        .select("id, code, name")
        .eq("code", serviceCode)
        .eq("is_active", true)
        .maybeSingle();

      if (serviceError || !service) {
        setError(
          "O serviÃ§o identificado ainda nÃ£o estÃ¡ disponÃ­vel no catÃ¡logo."
        );
        return;
      }

      const { data: request, error: requestError } = await supabase
        .from("requests")
        .insert({
          client_id: user.id,
          service_id: service.id,
          address_id: selectedAddressId,
          description: trimmedDescription,
          urgency,
          status: "pending",
        })
        .select("id")
        .single();

      if (requestError || !request) {
        setError(
          requestError?.message ||
            "NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel criar sua solicitaÃ§Ã£o."
        );
        return;
      }

      setDescription("");

        `SolicitaÃ§Ã£o criada para o serviÃ§o "${service.name}".`

              <div className="mt-5 border-t border-zinc-800 pt-5">
                <label className="mb-2 block text-sm text-zinc-400">
                  Usar outro endereÃ§o
                </label>

                <select
                  value={selectedAddressId}
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    setSelectedAddressId(event.target.value)
                  }
                  className="h-12 w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-950 px-4 text-sm text-white outline-none focus:border-green-500"
                >
                  {addresses.map((address) => (
                    <option
                      key={address.id}
                      value={address.id}
                    >
                      {address.label} â€” {address.street},{" "}
                      {address.number}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* URGÃŠNCIA */}
          <div className="mt-6">
            <p className="mb-3 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-300">
              Prioridade
            </p>

            <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setUrgency("normal")}
                className={`rounded-xl border p-4 text-left transition ${
                  urgency === "normal"
                    ? "border-green-500 bg-green-500/10"
                    : "border-zinc-700 bg-black hover:border-zinc-600"
                }`}
              >
                <p
                  className={`font-semibold ${
                    urgency === "normal"
                      ? "text-green-400"
                      : "text-white"
                  }`}
                >
                  Normal
                </p>

                <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500">
                  Quero resolver normalmente.
                </p>
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setUrgency("urgent")}
                className={`rounded-xl border p-4 text-left transition ${
                  urgency === "urgent"
                    ? "border-green-500 bg-green-500/10"
                    : "border-zinc-700 bg-black hover:border-zinc-600"
                }`}
              >
                <p
                  className={`font-semibold ${
                    urgency === "urgent"
                      ? "text-green-400"
                      : "text-white"
                  }`}
                >
                  Urgente
                </p>

                <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500">
                  Preciso resolver o quanto antes.
                </p>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {error && (
            <div className="mt-6 rounded-xl border border-red-500/30 bg-red-500/10 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-red-300">
              {error}
            </div>
          )}

          {message && (
            <div className="mt-6 rounded-xl border border-green-500/30 bg-green-500/10 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-green-300">
              {message}
            </div>
          )}

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleRequest}
            disabled={sending || !selectedAddressId}
            className="mt-6 w-full rounded-xl bg-green-500 px-6 py-4 text-base font-bold text-black transition hover:bg-green-400 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40"
          >
            {sending
              ? "Criando solicitaÃ§Ã£o..."
              : "Solicitar serviÃ§o â†’"}
          </button>
        </div>
      </section>
    </main>
  );
}

type Order = {
  id: string;
  service_id: string;
  address_id: string;
  price: number;
  currency: string;
  status: string;
  scheduled_start: string | null;
  scheduled_end: string | null;
  created_at: string;
};

type Service = {
  id: string;
  code: string;
  name: string;
};

type Address = {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  street: string;
  number: string;
  neighborhood: string;
  city: string;
  state: string;
};

type Appointment = {
  id: string;
  order_id: string;
  starts_at: string;
  ends_at: string;
  status: string;
};

type DisplayOrder = {
  order: Order;
  service?: Service;
  address?: Address;
  appointment?: Appointment;
};

type Filter =
  | "all"
  | "pending"
  | "waiting_schedule"
  | "scheduled"
  | "in_progress"
  | "completed"
  | "cancelled";

function formatCurrency(value: number) {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat("pt-BR", {
    style: "currency",
    currency: "BRL",
  }).format(value);
}

function formatDate(value: string) {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("pt-BR", {
    timeZone: "America/Sao_Paulo",
    day: "2-digit",
    month: "2-digit",
    year: "numeric",
  }).format(new Date(value));
}

function formatDateTime(value: string) {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("pt-BR", {
    timeZone: "America/Sao_Paulo",
    day: "2-digit",
    month: "2-digit",
    year: "numeric",
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
  }).format(new Date(value));
}

function formatTime(value: string) {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("pt-BR", {
    timeZone: "America/Sao_Paulo",
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
  }).format(new Date(value));
}

function getDisplayStatus(item: DisplayOrder) {
  const { order, appointment } = item;

  if (
    order.status === "cancelled" ||
    appointment?.status === "cancelled"
  ) {
    return {
      key: "cancelled" as Filter,
      label: "Cancelado",
      description: "Este serviÃ§o foi cancelado.",
      className:
        "border-red-500/40 bg-red-500/10 text-red-400",
    };
  }

  if (
    order.status === "completed" ||
    appointment?.status === "completed"
  ) {
    return {
      key: "completed" as Filter,
      label: "ConcluÃ­do",
      description: order.scheduled_end
        ? `ServiÃ§o realizado em ${formatDate(order.scheduled_end)}`
        : "ServiÃ§o realizado.",
      className:
        "border-green-500/40 bg-green-500/10 text-green-400",
    };
  }

  if (
    order.status === "in_progress" ||
    appointment?.status === "in_progress"
  ) {
    return {
      key: "in_progress" as Filter,
      label: "Em andamento",
      description: "O serviÃ§o estÃ¡ em execuÃ§Ã£o.",
      className:
        "border-blue-500/40 bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-400",
    };
  }

  if (appointment?.status === "confirmed") {
    return {
      key: "scheduled" as Filter,
      label: "Agendado",
      description: `${formatDate(appointment.starts_at)} Ã s ${formatTime(
        appointment.starts_at
      )}`,
      className:
        "border-blue-500/40 bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-400",
    };
  }

  if (appointment?.status === "scheduled") {
    return {
      key: "waiting_schedule" as Filter,
      label: "Aguardando confirmaÃ§Ã£o",
      description: `HorÃ¡rio solicitado em ${formatDateTime(
        appointment.starts_at
      )}`,
      className:
        "border-yellow-500/40 bg-yellow-500/10 text-yellow-400",
    };
  }

  if (
    order.status === "confirmed" ||
    order.status === "matched"
  ) {
    return {
      key: "waiting_schedule" as Filter,
      label: "Aguardando agendamento",
      description:
        "O serviÃ§o estÃ¡ confirmado. Escolha um horÃ¡rio disponÃ­vel.",
      className:
        "border-yellow-500/40 bg-yellow-500/10 text-yellow-400",
    };
  }

  return {
    key: "pending" as Filter,
    label: "Aguardando profissional",
    description: "Estamos buscando o profissional adequado.",
    className:
      "border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-300",
  };
}

function getFilterLabel(filter: Filter) {
  switch (filter) {
    case "all":
      return "Todos";
    case "pending":
      return "Aguardando profissional";
    case "waiting_schedule":
      return "Aguardando agendamento";
    case "scheduled":
      return "Agendado";
    case "in_progress":
      return "Em andamento";
    case "completed":
      return "ConcluÃ­do";
    case "cancelled":
      return "Cancelado";
  }
}

  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<Filter>("all");

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    async function loadServices() {
      const supabase = createSupabaseBrowserClient();

      const {
        data: { user },
      } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

      if (!user) {
        router.replace("/login");
        return;
      }

      const { data: profile, error: profileError } = await supabase
        .from("profiles")
        .select("full_name, user_type, status")
        .eq("id", user.id)
        .maybeSingle();

      if (cancelled) {
        return;
      }

      if (
        profileError ||
        !profile ||
        profile.user_type !== "client" ||
        profile.status === "blocked"
      ) {
        router.replace("/login");
        return;
      }

      setName(profile.full_name || "Cliente");

      const { data: orderData, error: orderError } = await supabase
        .from("orders")
        .select(
          "id, service_id, address_id, price, currency, status, scheduled_start, scheduled_end, created_at"
        )
        .eq("client_id", user.id)
        .order("created_at", { ascending: false });

      if (cancelled) {
        return;
      }

      if (orderError) {
        setErrorMessage(
          "NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel carregar seus serviÃ§os."
        );
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      const orderList = orderData ?? [];

      if (orderList.length === 0) {
        setOrders([]);
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      const serviceIds = [
        ...new Set(orderList.map((order) => order.service_id)),
      ];

      const addressIds = [
        ...new Set(orderList.map((order) => order.address_id)),
      ];

      const orderIds = orderList.map((order) => order.id);

      const [
        { data: serviceData },
        { data: addressData },
        { data: appointmentData },
      ] = await Promise.all([
        supabase
          .from("services")
          .select("id, code, name")
          .in("id", serviceIds),

        supabase
          .from("addresses")
          .select(
            "id, label, street, number, neighborhood, city, state"
          )
          .in("id", addressIds),

        supabase
          .from("appointments")
          .select(
            "id, order_id, starts_at, ends_at, status"
          )
          .in("order_id", orderIds)
          .order("starts_at", { ascending: false }),
      ]);

      if (cancelled) {
        return;
      }

      const serviceMap: Record<string, Service> = {};
      const addressMap: Record<string, Address> = {};
      const appointmentMap: Record<string, Appointment> = {};

      for (const service of serviceData ?? []) {
        serviceMap[service.id] = service;
      }

      for (const address of addressData ?? []) {
        addressMap[address.id] = address;
      }

      for (const appointment of appointmentData ?? []) {
        if (!appointmentMap[appointment.order_id]) {
          appointmentMap[appointment.order_id] = appointment;
        }
      }

      setOrders(
        orderList.map((order) => ({
          order,
          service: serviceMap[order.service_id],
          address: addressMap[order.address_id],
          appointment: appointmentMap[order.id],
        }))
      );

      setLoading(false);
    }

    void loadServices();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [router]);

  async function handleLogout() {
    const supabase = createSupabaseBrowserClient();

    await supabase.auth.signOut();

    router.replace("/login");
  }

  const filteredOrders = useMemo(() => {

    }

    return orders.filter(
      (item) => getDisplayStatus(item).key === filter
    );
  }, [orders, filter]);

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <main className="flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center bg-black text-white">
        <p className="text-sm text-zinc-400">
          Carregando seus serviÃ§os...
        </p>
      </main>
    );
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-black text-white">
      <header className="border-b border-zinc-800 bg-black">
        <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-6xl items-center justify-between px-6 py-5">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => router.push("/cliente")}
            className="flex items-center"
          >
            <Image
              src="/logo-vemgo.png"
              alt="VemGO"
              width={190}
              height={64}
              priority
              unoptimized
            />
          </button>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <div className="hidden text-right sm:block">
              <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500">
                Ãrea do cliente
              </p>

              <p className="text-sm text-zinc-200">
                OlÃ¡,{" "}
                <span className="font-semibold text-white">
                  {name}
                </span>
              </p>
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleLogout}
              className="rounded-xl border border-zinc-700 px-4 py-2 text-sm text-zinc-300 transition hover:border-green-500 hover:text-green-400"

"use client";

import Image from "next/image";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { createSupabaseBrowserClient } from "@/lib/supabase-browser";

type Verification = {
  verification_id: string;
  profile_id: string;
  full_name: string;
  user_type: string;
  identity_status: string;
  document_id: string | null;
  document_type: string | null;
  document_number: string | null;
  document_front_path: string | null;
  document_back_path: string | null;
  selfie_path: string | null;
  verification_status: string;
  created_at: string;
};

type SelectedVerification = Verification & {
  frontUrl: string | null;
  backUrl: string | null;
  selfieUrl: string | null;
};

export default function ControlePage() {
  const router = useRouter();

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [loadingList, setLoadingList] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const [adminName, setAdminName] = useState("");
  const [verifications, setVerifications] = useState<
    Verification[]
  >([]);

  const [selected, setSelected] =
    useState<SelectedVerification | null>(null);

  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const [rejectionReason, setRejectionReason] =
    useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    async function loadAdminAndVerifications() {
      const supabase = createSupabaseBrowserClient();

      const {
        data: { user },
      } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

      if (!user) {
        router.replace("/login");
        return;
      }

      const { data: profile, error: profileError } =
        await supabase
          .from("profiles")
          .select("full_name, user_type, status")
          .eq("id", user.id)
          .single();

      if (cancelled) {
        return;
      }

      if (
        profileError ||
        !profile ||
        profile.user_type !== "admin" ||
        profile.status !== "active"
      ) {
        router.replace("/login");
        return;
      }

      setAdminName(profile.full_name || "Administrador");
      setLoading(false);

      await loadVerifications();
    }

    async function loadVerifications() {
      setLoadingList(true);
      setError("");

      const supabase = createSupabaseBrowserClient();

      const {
        data,
        error: verificationError,
      } = await supabase.rpc(
        "get_pending_identity_verifications"
      );

      if (cancelled) {
        return;
      }

      if (verificationError) {
        setError(
          `NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel carregar as verificaÃ§Ãµes: ${verificationError.message}`
        );
        setLoadingList(false);
        return;
      }

      setVerifications(
        (data as Verification[]) || []
      );

      setLoadingList(false);
    }

    void Promise.resolve().then(
      loadAdminAndVerifications
    );

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [router]);

  async function openVerification(
    verification: Verification
  ) {
    setError("");
    setMessage("");

    const supabase = createSupabaseBrowserClient();

    let frontUrl: string | null = null;
    let backUrl: string | null = null;
    let selfieUrl: string | null = null;

    if (verification.document_front_path) {
      const { data, error } = await supabase.storage
        .from("identity-documents")
        .createSignedUrl(
          verification.document_front_path,
          600
        );

      if (error) {
        setError(
          `NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel abrir a frente do documento: ${error.message}`
        );
        return;
      }

      frontUrl = data.signedUrl;
    }

    if (verification.document_back_path) {
      const { data, error } = await supabase.storage
        .from("identity-documents")
        .createSignedUrl(
          verification.document_back_path,
          600
        );

      if (error) {
        setError(
          `NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel abrir o verso do documento: ${error.message}`
        );
        return;
      }

      backUrl = data.signedUrl;
    }

    if (verification.selfie_path) {
      const { data, error } = await supabase.storage
        .from("identity-documents")
        .createSignedUrl(
          verification.selfie_path,
          600
        );

      if (error) {
        setError(
          `NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel abrir a selfie: ${error.message}`
        );
        return;
      }

      selfieUrl = data.signedUrl;
    }

    setSelected({
      ...verification,
      frontUrl,
      backUrl,
      selfieUrl,
    });

    setRejectionReason("");
  }

  async function handleDecision(
    decision:
      | "approved"
      | "rejected"
      | "manual_review"
  ) {
    if (!selected) {
      return;
    }

    setError("");
    setMessage("");

    if (
      decision === "rejected" &&
      !rejectionReason.trim()
    ) {
      setError(
        "Informe o motivo da reprovaÃ§Ã£o."
      );
      return;
    }

    setSaving(true);

    const supabase = createSupabaseBrowserClient();

    const { error: decisionError } =
      await supabase.rpc(
        "review_identity_verification",
        {
          p_verification_id:
            selected.verification_id,
          p_decision: decision,
          p_rejection_reason:
            decision === "rejected"
              ? rejectionReason.trim()
              : null,
        }
      );

    if (decisionError) {
      setError(
        `NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel registrar a decisÃ£o: ${decisionError.message}`
      );
      setSaving(false);
      return;
    }

    let successMessage =
      "DecisÃ£o registrada com sucesso.";

    if (decision === "approved") {
      successMessage =
        "Identidade aprovada com sucesso.";
    }

    if (decision === "rejected") {
      successMessage =
        "Identidade reprovada com sucesso.";
    }

    if (decision === "manual_review") {
      successMessage =
        "Identidade enviada para anÃ¡lise manual.";
    }

    setMessage(successMessage);

    setVerifications((current) =>
      current.filter(
        (item) =>
          item.verification_id !==
          selected.verification_id
      )
    );

    setSelected(null);
    setRejectionReason("");
    setSaving(false);
  }

  async function handleLogout() {
    const supabase = createSupabaseBrowserClient();

    await supabase.auth.signOut();

    router.replace("/login");
  }

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <main className="flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center bg-zinc-950 text-white">
        <p className="text-sm text-zinc-400">
          Carregando VemGO Control...
        </p>
      </main>
    );
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-zinc-950 text-white">
      <header className="border-b border-zinc-800 bg-black">
        <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-7xl items-center justify-between gap-6 px-6 py-3">
          <div className="flex items-center">
            <Image
              src="/logo-vemgo.png"
              alt="VemGO"
              width={360}
              height={200}
              className="h-auto w-[190px] object-contain"
              priority
            />
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <div className="hidden text-right sm:block">
              <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500">
                VemGO Control
              </p>

              <p className="text-sm text-zinc-300">
                OlÃ¡,{" "}
                <span className="font-semibold text-white">
                  {adminName}
                </span>
              </p>
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={handleLogout}
              className="rounded-lg border border-zinc-700 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-300 transition hover:border-blue-500 hover:text-blue-400"
            >
              Sair
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>

      <section className="mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6 py-10">
        <div>
          <div className="mb-4 inline-flex rounded-full bg-blue-500/10 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-blue-400">
            PAINEL ADMINISTRATIVO
          </div>

          <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold">
            VerificaÃ§Ãµes de identidade
          </h2>

          <p className="mt-2 text-zinc-400">
            Analise a documentaÃ§Ã£o enviada pelos usuÃ¡rios
            antes de liberar a identidade.
          </p>
        </div>

        {message && (
          <div className="mt-6 rounded-xl border border-blue-900/50 bg-blue-950/30 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-blue-300">
            {message}
          </div>
        )}

        {error && (
          <div className="mt-6 rounded-xl border border-red-900/50 bg-red-950/30 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-red-300">
            {error}
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="mt-8 grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-[360px_1fr]">
          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-900/40 p-5">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <h3 className="font-semibold">
                Pendentes
              </h3>

              <span className="rounded-full bg-blue-500/10 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-blue-400">
                {verifications.length}
              </span>
            </div>

            {loadingList ? (
              <p className="mt-6 text-sm text-zinc-500">
                Carregando...
              </p>

              <div className="flex min-h-[500px] items-center justify-center text-center">
                <div>
                  <p className="text-lg font-semibold text-zinc-300">
                    Selecione um profissional
                  </p>

                  <p className="mt-2 max-w-md text-sm text-zinc-500">
                    Escolha um profissional na lista para
                    visualizar o cadastro e realizar a anÃ¡lise.
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div>
                <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-4 border-b border-zinc-800 pb-6 sm:flex-row sm:items-start">
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-500">
                      Profissional
                    </p>

                    <h2 className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold">
                      {selected.full_name}
                    </h2>

                    <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-zinc-400">
                      Identidade:{" "}
                      <span className="text-white">
                        {selected.identity_status}
                      </span>
                    </p>

                    <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-400">
                      VerificaÃ§Ã£o profissional:{" "}
                      <span className="text-white">
                        {selected.verification_status}
                      </span>
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  <span className="rounded-full bg-blue-500/10 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-blue-400">
                    Pendente
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="mt-6 grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
                  <div className="rounded-xl border border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-950 p-5">
                    <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500">
                      ServiÃ§os
                    </p>

                    <p className="mt-2 text-2xl font-bold">
                      {selected.services_count}
                    </p>

                    <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500">
                      serviÃ§os ativos
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  <div className="rounded-xl border border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-950 p-5">
                    <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500">
                      PreÃ§os
                    </p>

                    <p className="mt-2 text-2xl font-bold">
                      {selected.prices_count}
                    </p>

                    <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500">
                      preÃ§os ativos
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  <div className="rounded-xl border border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-950 p-5">
                    <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500">
                      RegiÃµes
                    </p>

                    <p className="mt-2 text-2xl font-bold">
                      {selected.regions_count}
                    </p>

                    <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500">
                      regiÃµes configuradas
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  <div className="rounded-xl border border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-950 p-5">
                    <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500">
                      Disponibilidade
                    </p>

                    <p className="mt-2 text-2xl font-bold">
                      {selected.availability_count}
                    </p>

                    <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500">
                      perÃ­odos configurados
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="mt-8 rounded-xl border border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-950 p-5">
                  <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-300">
                    Motivo da reprovaÃ§Ã£o
                  </p>

                  <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500">
                    ObrigatÃ³rio somente ao reprovar.
                  </p>

                  <textarea
                    value={rejectionReason}
                    onChange={(event) =>
                      setRejectionReason(event.target.value)
                    }
                    placeholder="Ex.: cadastro incompleto, informaÃ§Ãµes divergentes..."
                    className="mt-4 min-h-24 w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-900 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-white placeholder:text-zinc-600 outline-none focus:border-blue-500"
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="mt-6 flex flex-wrap gap-3">
                  <button
                    onClick={() =>
                      handleDecision("approved")
                    }
                    disabled={saving}
                    className="rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-5 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
                  >
                    Aprovar profissional
                  </button>

                  <button
                    onClick={() =>
                      handleDecision("rejected")
                    }
                    disabled={saving}
                    className="rounded-xl border border-red-700 px-5 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-red-400 transition hover:bg-red-950/30 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
                  >
                    Reprovar profissional
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>
    </main>
  );
}

"use client";

import { ChangeEvent, FormEvent, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { createSupabaseBrowserClient } from "@/lib/supabase-browser";

type IdentityStatus =
  | "unverified"
  | "pending"
  | "verified"
  | "rejected"
  | "manual_review";

type DocumentType = "cpf" | "rg" | "cnh" | "passport";

const MAX_FILE_SIZE = 10 * 1024 * 1024;

const ALLOWED_TYPES = [
  "image/jpeg",
  "image/png",
  "application/pdf",
];

const DOCUMENT_TYPE_LABELS: Record<DocumentType, string> = {
  cpf: "CPF",
  rg: "RG",
  cnh: "CNH",
  passport: "Passaporte",
};

export default function IdentidadePage() {
  const supabase = createSupabaseBrowserClient();

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);

  const [userId, setUserId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [identityStatus, setIdentityStatus] =
    useState<IdentityStatus>("unverified");

  const [documentType, setDocumentType] =
    useState<DocumentType>("cpf");

  const [documentNumber, setDocumentNumber] = useState("");

  const [frontFile, setFrontFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [backFile, setBackFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [selfieFile, setSelfieFile] = useState<File | null>(null);

  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const requiresBackDocument =
    documentType === "rg" || documentType === "cnh";

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    async function loadIdentityStatus() {
      const {
        data: { user },
        error: userError,
      } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

      if (cancelled) {
        return;
      }

      if (userError || !user) {
        setError("UsuÃ¡rio nÃ£o autenticado.");
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      setUserId(user.id);

      const { data: profile, error: profileError } =
        await supabase
          .from("profiles")
          .select("identity_status")
          .eq("id", user.id)
          .single();

      if (cancelled) {
        return;
      }

      if (profileError) {
        setError(
          "NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel carregar o status da identidade."
        );
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      setIdentityStatus(
        (profile.identity_status as IdentityStatus) ||
          "unverified"
      );

      setLoading(false);
    }

    void Promise.resolve().then(loadIdentityStatus);

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [supabase]);

  function validateFile(
    file: File | null,
    required = false
  ) {
    if (!file) {
      if (required) {
        return "Selecione o arquivo obrigatÃ³rio.";
      }

      return null;
    }

    if (!ALLOWED_TYPES.includes(file.type)) {
      return "Formato invÃ¡lido. Use JPG, PNG ou PDF.";
    }

    if (file.size > MAX_FILE_SIZE) {
      return "O arquivo deve ter no mÃ¡ximo 10 MB.";
    }

    return null;
  }

  function handleDocumentTypeChange(
    event: ChangeEvent<HTMLSelectElement>
  ) {
    const newType = event.target.value as DocumentType;

    setDocumentType(newType);
    setBackFile(null);
    setError("");
    setMessage("");
  }

  function handleFrontFileChange(
    event: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>
  ) {
    const file = event.target.files?.[0] || null;

    setFrontFile(file);
    setError("");
    setMessage("");
  }

  function handleBackFileChange(
    event: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>
  ) {
    const file = event.target.files?.[0] || null;

    setBackFile(file);
    setError("");
    setMessage("");
  }

  function handleSelfieChange(
    event: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>
  ) {
    const file = event.target.files?.[0] || null;

    setSelfieFile(file);
    setError("");
    setMessage("");
  }

  async function uploadFile(
    file: File,
    folder: string
  ) {
    if (!userId) {
      throw new Error("UsuÃ¡rio nÃ£o autenticado.");
    }

    const extension = file.name.includes(".")
      ? file.name.split(".").pop()?.toLowerCase()
      : "bin";

    const fileName = `${crypto.randomUUID()}.${extension}`;

    const path = `${userId}/${folder}/${fileName}`;

    const { error: uploadError } = await supabase.storage
      .from("identity-documents")
      .upload(path, file, {
        cacheControl: "3600",
        upsert: false,
      });

    if (uploadError) {
      throw uploadError;
    }

    return path;
  }

  async function handleSubmit(
    event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>
  ) {
    event.preventDefault();

    setError("");
    setMessage("");

    if (!userId) {
      setError("UsuÃ¡rio nÃ£o autenticado.");
      return;
    }

    const normalizedDocumentNumber =
      documentNumber.trim();

    if (!normalizedDocumentNumber) {
      setError("Informe o nÃºmero do documento.");
      return;
    }

    const frontValidation = validateFile(
      frontFile,
      true
    );

    if (frontValidation) {
      setError(frontValidation);
      return;
    }

    const backValidation = validateFile(
      backFile,
      requiresBackDocument
    );

    if (backValidation) {
      if (requiresBackDocument) {
        setError(
          `O verso do ${DOCUMENT_TYPE_LABELS[documentType]} Ã© obrigatÃ³rio.`
        );
      } else {
        setError(backValidation);
      }

      return;
    }

    const selfieValidation = validateFile(
      selfieFile,
      true
    );

    if (selfieValidation) {
      setError(selfieValidation);
      return;
    }

    setSending(true);

    try {
      if (!frontFile || !selfieFile) {
        throw new Error(
          "Documento da frente e selfie sÃ£o obrigatÃ³rios."
        );
      }

      const frontPath = await uploadFile(
        frontFile,
        "documents"
      );

      let backPath: string | null = null;

      if (backFile) {
        backPath = await uploadFile(
          backFile,
          "documents"
        );
      }

      const selfiePath = await uploadFile(
        selfieFile,
        "selfies"
      );

      const {
        data: identityDocument,
        error: documentError,
      } = await supabase
        .from("identity_documents")
        .insert({
          profile_id: userId,
          document_type: documentType,
          document_number: normalizedDocumentNumber,
          document_front_path: frontPath,
          document_back_path: backPath,
          verification_status: "pending",
        })
        .select("id")
        .single();

      if (documentError) {
        throw documentError;
      }

      const { error: verificationError } =
        await supabase
          .from("identity_verifications")
          .insert({
            profile_id: userId,
            identity_document_id:
              identityDocument.id,
            verification_type: "full_identity",
            status: "pending",
            selfie_path: selfiePath,
          });

      if (verificationError) {
        throw verificationError;
      }

      const {
        data: statusResult,
        error: statusError,
      } = await supabase.rpc(
        "submit_identity_for_review"
      );

      if (statusError) {
        throw statusError;
      }

      if (statusResult !== "pending") {
        throw new Error(
          "NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel confirmar o envio da identidade."
        );
      }

      setIdentityStatus("pending");

      setMessage(
        "Sua documentaÃ§Ã£o foi enviada e estÃ¡ aguardando anÃ¡lise."
      );

      setDocumentNumber("");
      setFrontFile(null);
      setBackFile(null);
      setSelfieFile(null);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);

      setError(
        err instanceof Error
          ? err.message
          : "NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel enviar sua documentaÃ§Ã£o."
      );
    } finally {
      setSending(false);
    }
  }

  function renderStatus() {
    if (identityStatus === "pending") {
      return (
        <div className="space-y-6">
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-900/70 p-5">
            <p className="text-sm text-zinc-400">
              Status
            </p>

            <p className="mt-2 font-semibold text-white">
              Em anÃ¡lise pela VemGO
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="rounded-xl border border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-900/70 p-5">
            <p className="text-sm text-zinc-300">
              Sua documentaÃ§Ã£o foi recebida e estÃ¡
              aguardando anÃ¡lise.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }

    if (identityStatus === "verified") {
      return (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-900/70 p-5">
          <p className="text-sm text-zinc-400">
            Status
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 font-semibold text-white">
            Identidade verificada
          </p>

          <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-zinc-400">
            Sua identidade foi confirmada pela VemGO.
          </p>
        </div>
      );
    }

    if (identityStatus === "manual_review") {
      return (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-900/70 p-5">
          <p className="text-sm text-zinc-400">
            Status
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 font-semibold text-white">
            Em anÃ¡lise manual
          </p>

          <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-zinc-400">
            Sua documentaÃ§Ã£o precisa de uma anÃ¡lise
            adicional pela equipe VemGO.
          </p>
        </div>
      );
    }

    if (identityStatus === "rejected") {
      return (
        <div className="space-y-6">
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-900/70 p-5">
            <p className="text-sm text-zinc-400">
              Status
            </p>

            <p className="mt-2 font-semibold text-white">
              VerificaÃ§Ã£o nÃ£o aprovada
            </p>

            <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-zinc-400">
              Sua documentaÃ§Ã£o nÃ£o foi aprovada. Envie
              uma nova documentaÃ§Ã£o para anÃ¡lise.
            </p>
          </div>

          {renderForm()}
        </div>
      );
    }

    return renderForm();
  }

  function renderForm() {
    return (
      <form
        onSubmit={handleSubmit}
        className="space-y-6"
      >
        <div>
          <label
            htmlFor="documentType"
            className="mb-2 block text-sm text-zinc-300"
          >
            Tipo de documento
          </label>

          <select
            id="documentType"
            value={documentType}
            onChange={handleDocumentTypeChange}
            className="w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-900 px-4 py-3 text-white outline-none focus:border-zinc-500"
          >
            <option value="cpf">CPF</option>
            <option value="rg">RG</option>
            <option value="cnh">CNH</option>
            <option value="passport">
              Passaporte
            </option>
          </select>
        </div>

        <div>
          <label
            htmlFor="documentNumber"
            className="mb-2 block text-sm text-zinc-300"
          >
            NÃºmero do documento
          </label>

          <input
            id="documentNumber"
            type="text"
            value={documentNumber}
            onChange={(event) =>
              setDocumentNumber(event.target.value)
            }
            placeholder="Digite o nÃºmero do documento"
            required
            className="w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-900 px-4 py-3 text-white placeholder:text-zinc-500 outline-none focus:border-zinc-500"
          />
        </div>

        <div>
          <label
            htmlFor="frontFile"
            className="mb-2 block text-sm text-zinc-300"
          >
            Documento â€” frente
          </label>

          <input
            id="frontFile"
            type="file"
            accept="image/jpeg,image/png,application/pdf"
            onChange={handleFrontFileChange}
            required
            className="block w-full text-sm text-zinc-400 file:mr-4 file:rounded-lg file:border-0 file:bg-zinc-800 file:px-4 file:py-2 file:text-sm file:text-white"
          />

          <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-zinc-500">
            JPG, PNG ou PDF. MÃ¡ximo de 10 MB.
          </p>
        </div>

        {requiresBackDocument && (
          <div>
            <label
              htmlFor="backFile"
              className="mb-2 block text-sm text-zinc-300"

              Documento â€” verso
              <span className="ml-2 text-xs font-semibold text-red-400">
                obrigatÃ³rio
              </span>
            </label>

            <input

              type="file"
              accept="image/jpeg,image/png,application/pdf"

"use client";

import Image from "next/image";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter, useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import { createSupabaseBrowserClient } from "@/lib/supabase-browser";

type LoginMode = "client" | "professional";

const onboardingRoutes: Record<number, string> = {
  1: "/cadastro-profissional",
  2: "/cadastro-profissional/endereco",
  3: "/cadastro-profissional/foto",
  4: "/cadastro-profissional/identidade",
  5: "/cadastro-profissional/competencias",
  6: "/cadastro-profissional/precos",
  7: "/cadastro-profissional/disponibilidade",
  8: "/cadastro-profissional/area-atendimento",
  9: "/cadastro-profissional/plano",
};

function getNextOnboardingRoute(step: number | null | undefined) {
  if (!step || step < 1) {
    return "/cadastro-profissional";
  }

  if (step >= 10) {
    return "/profissional";
  }

  return onboardingRoutes[step] ?? "/profissional";
}

export default function LoginPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const supabase = createSupabaseBrowserClient();

  const [mode, setMode] = useState<LoginMode>("client");
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const isProfessional = mode === "professional";

  useEffect(() => {
    const role = searchParams.get("role");

    if (role === "professional") {
      setMode("professional");
    }

    if (role === "client") {
      setMode("client");
    }
  }, [searchParams]);

  async function resolveProfessionalDestination(userId: string) {
    const { data: profile, error: profileError } = await supabase
      .from("profiles")
      .select("professional_onboarding_step")
      .eq("id", userId)
      .single();

    if (profileError || !profile) {
      throw new Error(
        "NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel verificar o andamento do seu cadastro profissional.",
      );
    }

    const storedStep = Number(profile.professional_onboarding_step ?? 1);

    const { data: address, error: addressError } = await supabase
      .from("addresses")
      .select("id")
      .eq("profile_id", userId)
      .limit(1)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (addressError) {
      throw new Error(
        "NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel verificar seu endereÃ§o profissional.",
      );
    }

    if (!address) {
      if (storedStep !== 1 && storedStep !== 2) {
        await supabase
          .from("profiles")
          .update({
            professional_onboarding_step: 2,
          })
          .eq("id", userId);
      }

      return "/cadastro-profissional/endereco";
    }

    const { data: profilePhoto, error: photoError } = await supabase
      .from("profiles")
      .select("avatar_url")
      .eq("id", userId)
      .single();

    if (photoError) {
      throw new Error(
        "NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel verificar sua foto de perfil.",
      );
    }

    if (!profilePhoto?.avatar_url) {
      await supabase
        .from("profiles")
        .update({
          professional_onboarding_step: 3,
        })
        .eq("id", userId);

      return "/cadastro-profissional/foto";
    }

    const {
      data: identityVerification,
      error: identityError,
    } = await supabase
      .from("identity_verifications")
      .select("id, status")
      .eq("profile_id", userId)
      .order("created_at", {
        ascending: false,
      })
      .limit(1)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (identityError) {
      throw new Error(
        "NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel verificar sua identidade.",
      );
    }

    const identityCompleted =
      identityVerification &&
      [
        "pending",
        "processing",
        "manual_review",
        "approved",
      ].includes(identityVerification.status);

    if (!identityCompleted) {
      await supabase
        .from("profiles")
        .update({
          professional_onboarding_step: 4,
        })
        .eq("id", userId);

      return "/cadastro-profissional/identidade";
    }

    const {
      data: professionalServices,
      error: servicesError,
    } = await supabase
      .from("professional_services")
      .select("service_id")
      .eq("professional_id", userId)
      .limit(1)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (servicesError) {
      throw new Error(
        "NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel verificar suas competÃªncias.",
      );
    }

    if (!professionalServices) {
      await supabase
        .from("profiles")
        .update({
          professional_onboarding_step: 5,
        })
        .eq("id", userId);

      return "/cadastro-profissional/competencias";
    }

    const {
      data: professionalPrice,
      error: priceError,
    } = await supabase
      .from("service_prices")
      .select("service_id")
      .eq("professional_id", userId)
      .limit(1)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (priceError) {
      throw new Error(
        "NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel verificar seus preÃ§os.",
      );
    }

    if (!professionalPrice) {
      await supabase
        .from("profiles")
        .update({
          professional_onboarding_step: 6,
        })
        .eq("id", userId);

      return "/cadastro-profissional/precos";
    }

    const {
      data: availability,
      error: availabilityError,
    } = await supabase
      .from("professional_availability")
      .select("id")
      .eq("professional_id", userId)
      .limit(1)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (availabilityError) {
      throw new Error(
        "NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel verificar sua disponibilidade.",
      );
    }

    if (!availability) {
      await supabase
        .from("profiles")
        .update({
          professional_onboarding_step: 7,
        })
        .eq("id", userId);

      return "/cadastro-profissional/disponibilidade";
    }

    const {
      data: region,
      error: regionError,
    } = await supabase
      .from("professional_regions")
      .select("id")
      .eq("professional_id", userId)
      .eq("is_active", true)
      .limit(1)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (regionError) {
      throw new Error(
        "NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel verificar sua Ã¡rea de atendimento.",
      );
    }

    if (!region) {
      await supabase
        .from("profiles")
        .update({
          professional_onboarding_step: 8,
        })
        .eq("id", userId);

      return "/cadastro-profissional/area-atendimento";
    }

    if (storedStep < 9) {
      await supabase
        .from("profiles")
        .update({
          professional_onboarding_step: 9,
        })
        .eq("id", userId);

      return "/cadastro-profissional/plano";
    }

    return getNextOnboardingRoute(storedStep);
  }

  async function handleLogin(
    event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>,
  ) {
    event.preventDefault();

    setError("");
    setLoading(true);

    const { data, error: loginError } =
      await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({
        email: email.trim(),
        password,
      });

    if (loginError || !data.user) {
      setError("E-mail ou senha invÃ¡lidos.");
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    const { data: profile, error: profileError } =
      await supabase
        .from("profiles")
        .select("user_type, status")
        .eq("id", data.user.id)
        .single();

    if (profileError || !profile) {
      await supabase.auth.signOut();

      setError(
        "NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel carregar o perfil da sua conta.",
      );

      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    if (profile.status === "blocked") {
      await supabase.auth.signOut();

      setError(
        "Sua conta estÃ¡ bloqueada. Entre em contato com a VemGO.",
      );

      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    if (
      isProfessional &&
      profile.user_type === "client"
    ) {
      await supabase.auth.signOut();

      setError(
        "Esta Ã© uma conta de cliente. Selecione Cliente para entrar.",
      );

      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    if (
      !isProfessional &&
      profile.user_type === "professional"
    ) {
      await supabase.auth.signOut();

      setError(
        "Esta Ã© uma conta de profissional. Selecione Profissional para entrar.",
      );

      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    if (profile.user_type === "professional") {
      try {
        const destination =
          await resolveProfessionalDestination(
            data.user.id,
          );

        router.replace(destination);
        return;
      } catch (destinationError) {
        await supabase.auth.signOut();

        setError(
          destinationError instanceof Error
            ? destinationError.message
            : "NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel verificar seu cadastro profissional.",
        );

        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }
    }

    if (profile.user_type === "company") {
      router.replace("/empresa");
      return;
    }

    if (profile.user_type === "admin") {
      router.replace("/controle");
      return;
    }

    router.replace("/cliente");
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-black px-6 py-10 text-white">
      <div className="mx-auto flex min-h-[85vh] max-w-md flex-col justify-center">
        <div className="mb-8 text-center">
          <Image
            src="/logo-vemgo.png"
            alt="VemGO"
            width={360}
            height={200}
            className="mx-auto h-auto w-[190px] object-contain"
            priority
          />

          <h1 className="mt-6 text-3xl font-bold">
            {isProfessional
              ? "Ãrea do profissional"
              : "Entrar"}
          </h1>

          <p className="mt-2 text-zinc-400">
            {isProfessional
              ? "Acesse sua conta profissional VemGO."
              : "Acesse sua conta VemGO."}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="mb-5 rounded-2xl border border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-900/60 p-1.5">
          <p className="mb-2 px-3 pt-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-500">
            Entrar como
          </p>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setMode("client");
                setError("");
              }}
              className={`rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-sm font-bold transition ${
                !isProfessional
                  ? "bg-emerald-600 text-black shadow-lg"
                  : "text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-800 hover:text-white"
              }`}
            >
              Cliente
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setMode("professional");
                setError("");
              }}
              className={`rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-sm font-bold transition ${
                isProfessional
                  ? "bg-orange-500 text-black shadow-lg"
                  : "text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-800 hover:text-white"
              }`}
            >
              Profissional
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <form
          onSubmit={handleLogin}
          className={`rounded-2xl border bg-zinc-900/40 p-6 ${
            isProfessional
              ? "border-orange-500/30"
              : "border-emerald-500/20"
          }`}
        >
          <div>
            <label
              htmlFor="email"
              className="text-sm font-medium text-zinc-200"
            >

            <input

type SupabaseError = {
  message?: string;
};

const supabase = createSupabaseBrowserClient();

function getErrorMessage(
  error: unknown,
  fallback: string
) {
  if (
    typeof error === "object" &&
    error !== null &&
    "message" in error
  ) {
    const message = (error as SupabaseError).message;

    if (
      typeof message === "string" &&
      message.length > 0
    ) {
      return message;
    }
  }

  return fallback;
}

function formatCurrency(value: number) {
  return value.toLocaleString("pt-BR", {
    style: "currency",
    currency: "BRL",
  });
}

function formatDateTime(
  dateString: string
) {
  return new Date(dateString).toLocaleString(
    "pt-BR",
    {
      weekday: "long",
      day: "2-digit",
      month: "long",
      year: "numeric",
      hour: "2-digit",
      minute: "2-digit",
    }
  );
}

function formatTime(dateString: string) {
  return new Date(dateString).toLocaleTimeString(
    "pt-BR",
    {
      hour: "2-digit",
      minute: "2-digit",
    }
  );
}

import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";

type AppointmentStatus =
  | "scheduled"
  | "confirmed"
  | "in_progress"
  | "completed"
  | "cancelled"
  | "no_show";

type Appointment = {
  id: string;
  order_id: string;
  professional_id: string;
  starts_at: string;
  ends_at: string;
  status: AppointmentStatus;
  confirmed_at: string | null;
  cancelled_at: string | null;
  cancellation_reason: string | null;
};

type Order = {
  id: string;
  client_id: string;
  professional_id: string;
  service_id: string;
  price: number;
  currency: string;
  status: string;
};

type Service = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  code: string;
};


function formatDate(date: string) {
  return new Date(date).toLocaleDateString("pt-BR", {
    weekday: "long",
    day: "2-digit",
    month: "2-digit",
    year: "numeric",
  });
}

function formatTime(date: string) {
  return new Date(date).toLocaleTimeString("pt-BR", {
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
  });
}

function formatPrice(price: number) {
  return Number(price).toLocaleString("pt-BR", {
    style: "currency",
    currency: "BRL",
  });
}

function statusLabel(status: AppointmentStatus) {
  switch (status) {
    case "scheduled":
      return "Aguardando confirmaÃ§Ã£o";

    case "confirmed":
      return "Confirmado";

    case "in_progress":
      return "Em andamento";

    case "completed":
      return "ConcluÃ­do";

    case "cancelled":
      return "Cancelado";

    case "no_show":
      return "NÃ£o compareceu";

    default:
      return status;
  }
}

function statusClass(status: AppointmentStatus) {
  switch (status) {
    case "scheduled":
      return "border-orange-500/40 bg-orange-500/10 text-orange-400";

    case "confirmed":
      return "border-orange-500/40 bg-orange-500/10 text-orange-400";

    case "in_progress":
      return "border-orange-500/40 bg-orange-500/10 text-orange-400";

    case "completed":
      return "border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-300";

    case "cancelled":
      return "border-red-900 bg-red-950/30 text-red-400";

    case "no_show":
      return "border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-400";

    default:
      return "border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-300";
  }
}

export default function ProfessionalAppointmentsPage() {
  const router = useRouter();

  const [name, setName] = useState("Profissional");
  const [appointments, setAppointments] = useState<Appointment[]>([]);
  const [orders, setOrders] = useState<Record<string, Order>>({});
  const [services, setServices] = useState<Record<string, Service>>({});
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const supabase = createSupabaseBrowserClient();

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    async function loadPage() {
      setLoading(true);
      setError("");

      const {
        data: { user },
      } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

      if (!user) {
        router.replace("/login");
        return;
      }

      const { data: profile, error: profileError } = await supabase
        .from("profiles")
        .select("full_name, user_type")
        .eq("id", user.id)
        .maybeSingle();

      if (cancelled) return;

      if (profileError) {
        setError(
          `NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel carregar seu perfil: ${profileError.message}`
        );
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      if (!profile || profile.user_type !== "professional") {
        router.replace("/cliente");
        return;
      }

      setName(profile.full_name || "Profissional");

      const { data: appointmentData, error: appointmentError } =
        await supabase
          .from("appointments")
          .select(
            "id, order_id, professional_id, starts_at, ends_at, status, confirmed_at, cancelled_at, cancellation_reason"
          )
          .eq("professional_id", user.id)
          .order("starts_at", { ascending: true });

      if (cancelled) return;

      if (appointmentError) {
        setError(
          `NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel carregar os agendamentos: ${appointmentError.message}`
        );
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      const appointmentRows = (appointmentData || []) as Appointment[];

      setAppointments(appointmentRows);

      const orderIds = [
        ...new Set(appointmentRows.map((appointment) => appointment.order_id)),
      ];

      if (orderIds.length === 0) {
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      const { data: orderData, error: orderError } = await supabase
        .from("orders")
        .select(
          "id, client_id, professional_id, service_id, price, currency, status"
        )
        .in("id", orderIds);

      if (cancelled) return;

      if (orderError) {
        setError(
          `NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel carregar os pedidos: ${orderError.message}`
        );
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      const orderRows = (orderData || []) as Order[];

      const orderMap: Record<string, Order> = {};

      for (const order of orderRows) {
        orderMap[order.id] = order;
      }

      setOrders(orderMap);

      const serviceIds = [
        ...new Set(orderRows.map((order) => order.service_id)),
      ];

      if (serviceIds.length > 0) {
        const { data: serviceData, error: serviceError } = await supabase
          .from("services")
          .select("id, name, code")
          .in("id", serviceIds);

        if (cancelled) return;

        if (!serviceError) {
          const serviceRows = (serviceData || []) as Service[];

          const serviceMap: Record<string, Service> = {};

          for (const service of serviceRows) {
            serviceMap[service.id] = service;
          }

          setServices(serviceMap);
        }
      }

      setLoading(false);
    }

    void loadPage();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [router]);

  async function handleLogout() {
    await supabase.auth.signOut();
    router.replace("/login");
  }

  const pendingAppointments = useMemo(
    () =>
      appointments.filter(
        (appointment) => appointment.status === "scheduled"
      ),
    [appointments]
  );

  const confirmedAppointments = useMemo(
    () =>
      appointments.filter(
        (appointment) => appointment.status === "confirmed"
      ),
    [appointments]
  );

  const otherAppointments = useMemo(
    () =>
      appointments.filter(
        (appointment) =>
          appointment.status !== "scheduled" &&
          appointment.status !== "confirmed"
      ),
    [appointments]
  );

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <main className="min-h-screen bg-[#0C0A09] px-6 py-12 text-white">
        <div className="mx-auto max-w-5xl">
          <p className="text-zinc-400">Carregando agendamentos...</p>
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-[#0C0A09] text-white">
      <header className="border-b border-zinc-800 bg-black">
        <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-5xl items-center justify-between px-6 py-5">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => router.push("/profissional")}
            className="flex items-center"
          >
            <Image
              src="/logo-vemgo.png"
              alt="VemGO"
              width={190}
              height={64}
              priority
              unoptimized
            />
          </button>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <div className="hidden text-right sm:block">
              <div className="text-xs text-zinc-500">
                Ãrea do profissional
              </div>

              <div className="text-sm text-zinc-300">
                OlÃ¡,{" "}
                <span className="font-semibold text-white">{name}</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleLogout}
              className="rounded-xl border border-zinc-700 px-4 py-2 text-sm text-zinc-300 transition hover:border-orange-500 hover:text-orange-400"
            >
