"use client";

import Image from "next/image";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { createSupabaseBrowserClient } from "@/lib/supabase-browser";

type Availability = {
  id: string;
  day_of_week: number;
  start_time: string;
  end_time: string;
  is_active: boolean;
};

const DAYS = [
  { value: 1, label: "Segunda-feira" },
  { value: 2, label: "TerÃ§a-feira" },
  { value: 3, label: "Quarta-feira" },
  { value: 4, label: "Quinta-feira" },
  { value: 5, label: "Sexta-feira" },
  { value: 6, label: "SÃ¡bado" },
  { value: 0, label: "Domingo" },
];

export default function ProfissionalDisponibilidadePage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const supabase = createSupabaseBrowserClient();

  const [availability, setAvailability] = useState<Availability[]>(
    [],
  );

  const [dayOfWeek, setDayOfWeek] = useState("1");
  const [startTime, setStartTime] = useState("08:00");
  const [endTime, setEndTime] = useState("18:00");
  const [name, setName] = useState("Profissional");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    async function loadAvailability() {
      const {
        data: { user },
      } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

      if (!user) {
        router.replace("/login");
        return;
      }

      const { data: profile } = await supabase
        .from("profiles")
        .select("full_name, user_type, status")
        .eq("id", user.id)
        .maybeSingle();

      if (!profile) {
        router.replace("/login");
        return;
      }

      if (profile.status === "blocked") {
        await supabase.auth.signOut();
        router.replace("/login");
        return;
      }

      if (profile.user_type === "client") {
        router.replace("/cliente");
        return;
      }

      if (profile.user_type === "admin") {
        router.replace("/controle");
        return;
      }

      if (profile.user_type === "company") {
        router.replace("/empresa");
        return;
      }

      if (profile.user_type !== "professional") {
        router.replace("/login");
        return;
      }

      setName(profile.full_name || "Profissional");

      const { data, error: availabilityError } =
        await supabase
          .from("professional_availability")
          .select(
            "id, day_of_week, start_time, end_time, is_active",
          )
          .eq("professional_id", user.id)
          .eq("is_active", true)
          .order("day_of_week", { ascending: true })
          .order("start_time", { ascending: true });

      if (availabilityError) {
        setError(
          `NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel carregar sua disponibilidade: ${availabilityError.message}`,
        );
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      setAvailability(data || []);
      setLoading(false);
    }

    void Promise.resolve().then(loadAvailability);
  }, [router, supabase]);

  function getDayLabel(day: number) {
    return (
      DAYS.find((item) => item.value === day)?.label ||
      "Dia nÃ£o identificado"
    );
  }

  function handleAddAvailability() {
    setMessage("");
    setError("");

    if (!startTime || !endTime) {
      setError("Informe o horÃ¡rio inicial e final.");
      return;
    }

    if (startTime >= endTime) {
      setError(
        "O horÃ¡rio inicial precisa ser anterior ao horÃ¡rio final.",
      );
      return;
    }

    const selectedDay = Number(dayOfWeek);

    const alreadyExists = availability.some(
      (item) =>
        item.day_of_week === selectedDay &&
        item.start_time.slice(0, 5) === startTime &&
        item.end_time.slice(0, 5) === endTime,
    );

    if (alreadyExists) {
      setError("Esse horÃ¡rio jÃ¡ estÃ¡ cadastrado.");
      return;
    }

    setAvailability((current) => [
      ...current,
      {
        id: `new-${Date.now()}-${Math.random()}`,
        day_of_week: selectedDay,
        start_time: startTime,
        end_time: endTime,
        is_active: true,
      },
    ]);
  }

  function handleRemoveAvailability(id: string) {
    setAvailability((current) =>
      current.filter((item) => item.id !== id),
    );
  }

  async function handleSave() {
    setMessage("");
    setError("");

    if (availability.length === 0) {
      setError(
        "Cadastre pelo menos um horÃ¡rio de disponibilidade.",
      );
      return;
    }

    setSaving(true);

    const {
      data: { user },
    } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

    if (!user) {
      router.replace("/login");
      return;
    }

    const { data: profile } = await supabase
      .from("profiles")
      .select("user_type, status")
      .eq("id", user.id)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (
      !profile ||
      profile.user_type !== "professional" ||
      profile.status !== "active"
    ) {
      router.replace("/login");
      return;
    }

    const { error: deactivateError } = await supabase
      .from("professional_availability")
      .update({ is_active: false })
      .eq("professional_id", user.id)
      .eq("is_active", true);

    if (deactivateError) {
      setError(
        `NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel atualizar a disponibilidade: ${deactivateError.message}`,
      );
      setSaving(false);
      return;
    }

    const rows = availability.map((item) => ({
      professional_id: user.id,
      day_of_week: item.day_of_week,
      start_time: item.start_time,
      end_time: item.end_time,
      is_active: true,
    }));

    const {
      data: insertedAvailability,
      error: insertError,
    } = await supabase
      .from("professional_availability")
      .insert(rows)
      .select(
        "id, day_of_week, start_time, end_time, is_active",
      );

    if (insertError) {
      setError(
        `NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel salvar a disponibilidade: ${insertError.message}`,
      );
      setSaving(false);
      return;
    }

    setAvailability(insertedAvailability || []);

    setMessage("Disponibilidade salva com sucesso.");

    setSaving(false);
  }

  async function handleLogout() {
    await supabase.auth.signOut();
    router.replace("/login");
  }

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <main className="min-h-screen bg-[#0C0A09] px-6 py-12 text-white">

      </main>
    );
  }

  return (

          <div className="flex items-center">

type ResponseResult = {
  match_id: string;
  match_status: string;
  request_id: string;
  request_status: string;
  order_id: string | null;

export default function OportunidadeDetalhePage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const params = useParams();

  const matchId =
    typeof params.id === "string"
      ? params.id
      : Array.isArray(params.id)
        ? params.id[0]
        : "";

  const [opportunity, setOpportunity] =
    useState<Opportunity | null>(null);

  const [name, setName] = useState("Profissional");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [processing, setProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [confirmed, setConfirmed] = useState(false);
  const [orderId, setOrderId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    async function loadOpportunity() {
      if (!matchId) {
        setMessage("Oportunidade invÃ¡lida.");
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      const supabase = createSupabaseBrowserClient();

      const {
        data: { user },
      } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

      if (!user) {
        router.replace("/login");
        return;
      }

      const { data: profile, error: profileError } =
        await supabase
          .from("profiles")
          .select("full_name, user_type, status")
          .eq("id", user.id)
          .maybeSingle();

        return;
      }

        return;

        router.replace("/login");
        return;
      }

      if (profile.user_type !== "professional") {
        if (profile.user_type === "client") {
          router.replace("/cliente");
        } else if (profile.user_type === "admin") {
          router.replace("/controle");
        } else if (profile.user_type === "company") {
          router.replace("/empresa");
        } else {
          router.replace("/login");
        }

        return;
      }

      setName(profile.full_name || "Profissional");

      const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc(
        "get_professional_opportunities"
      );

        return;

    void loadOpportunity();

  async function handleLogout() {
    const supabase = createSupabaseBrowserClient();

    await supabase.auth.signOut();

    router.replace("/login");
  }

  async function handleResponse(

    if (!matchId || processing || confirmed) {

    setMessage("");
    setProcessing(true);

      );
      setProcessing(false);

    if (decision === "declined") {

      return;
    }

    setConfirmed(true);
    setOrderId(result.order_id);

  function formatPrice(price: number | null) {
    if (price === null || price === undefined) {

  function formatDate(date: string) {

      dateStyle: "short",

  if (loading) {

import { createSupabaseBrowserClient } from "@/lib/supabase-browser";

type Appointment = {
  id: string;
  order_id: string;
  starts_at: string;
  ends_at: string;
  status: string;
};

type Order = {
  id: string;
  service_id: string;
  price: number;
  currency: string;
};

type Service = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  code: string;
};

const onboardingRoutes: Record<number, string> = {
  1: "/cadastro-profissional",
  2: "/cadastro-profissional/endereco",
  3: "/cadastro-profissional/foto",
  4: "/cadastro-profissional/identidade",
  5: "/cadastro-profissional/competencias",
  6: "/cadastro-profissional/precos",
  7: "/cadastro-profissional/disponibilidade",
  8: "/cadastro-profissional/area-atendimento",
  9: "/cadastro-profissional/plano",
};

export default function ProfissionalPage() {
  const router = useRouter();

  const [name, setName] = useState("Profissional");
  const [identityStatus, setIdentityStatus] = useState("unverified");
  const [verificationStatus, setVerificationStatus] = useState("pending");
  const [serviceStatus, setServiceStatus] = useState("inactive");

  const [pendingAppointments, setPendingAppointments] = useState<
    Appointment[]
  >([]);

  const [orders, setOrders] = useState<Record<string, Order>>({});
  const [services, setServices] = useState<Record<string, Service>>({});

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    async function loadProfessional() {
      const supabase = createSupabaseBrowserClient();

      const {
        data: { user },
      } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

      if (!user) {
        router.replace("/login");
        return;
      }

      const { data: profile, error: profileError } = await supabase
        .from("profiles")
        .select(
          "full_name, user_type, status, identity_status, professional_onboarding_step",
        )
        .eq("id", user.id)
        .maybeSingle();

      if (cancelled) return;

      if (profileError || !profile) {
        router.replace("/login");
        return;
      }

      if (profile.status === "blocked") {
        await supabase.auth.signOut();
        router.replace("/login");
        return;
      }

      if (profile.user_type === "client") {
        router.replace("/cliente");
        return;
      }

      if (profile.user_type === "admin") {
        router.replace("/controle");
        return;
      }

      if (profile.user_type === "company") {
        router.replace("/empresa");
        return;
      }

      if (profile.user_type !== "professional") {
        router.replace("/login");
        return;
      }

      const onboardingStep =
        profile.professional_onboarding_step ?? 1;

      const onboardingRoute = onboardingRoutes[onboardingStep];

      if (onboardingRoute) {
        router.replace(onboardingRoute);
        return;
      }

      setName(profile.full_name || "Profissional");

      const { data: approvedVerification } = await supabase
        .from("identity_verifications")
        .select("id, status, verification_type, verified_at")
        .eq("profile_id", user.id)
        .eq("status", "approved")
        .order("verified_at", { ascending: false })
        .limit(1)
        .maybeSingle();

      if (cancelled) return;

      if (
        profile.identity_status === "verified" ||
        approvedVerification?.status === "approved"
      ) {
        setIdentityStatus("verified");
      } else {
        setIdentityStatus(profile.identity_status || "unverified");
      }

      const { data: professional } = await supabase
        .from("professionals")
        .select("verification_status, service_status")
        .eq("id", user.id)
        .maybeSingle();

      if (cancelled) return;

      if (professional) {
        setVerificationStatus(professional.verification_status);
        setServiceStatus(professional.service_status);
      }

      const { data: appointmentData } = await supabase
        .from("appointments")
        .select("id, order_id, starts_at, ends_at, status")
        .eq("professional_id", user.id)
        .eq("status", "scheduled")
        .order("starts_at", { ascending: true });

      if (cancelled) return;

      const appointments = (appointmentData || []) as Appointment[];

      setPendingAppointments(appointments);

      const orderIds = [
        ...new Set(
          appointments.map(
            (appointment) => appointment.order_id,
          ),
        ),
      ];

      if (orderIds.length > 0) {
        const { data: orderData } = await supabase
          .from("orders")
          .select("id, service_id, price, currency")
          .in("id", orderIds);

        if (cancelled) return;

        const orderMap: Record<string, Order> = {};

        for (const order of (orderData || []) as Order[]) {
          orderMap[order.id] = order;
        }

        setOrders(orderMap);

        const serviceIds = [
          ...new Set(
            (orderData || []).map(
              (order) => order.service_id,
            ),
          ),
        ];

        if (serviceIds.length > 0) {
          const { data: serviceData } = await supabase
            .from("services")
            .select("id, name, code")
            .in("id", serviceIds);

          if (cancelled) return;

          const serviceMap: Record<string, Service> = {};

          for (const service of (serviceData ||
            []) as Service[]) {
            serviceMap[service.id] = service;
          }

          setServices(serviceMap);
        }
      }

      setLoading(false);
    }

    void loadProfessional();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [router]);

  async function handleLogout() {
    const supabase = createSupabaseBrowserClient();

  if (loading) {

import Image from "next/image";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { createSupabaseBrowserClient } from "@/lib/supabase-browser";

type ProfessionalService = {
  service_id: string;
  code: string;
  name: string;
  price: number | null;
};

export default function ProfissionalPrecosPage() {
  const router = useRouter();

  const [services, setServices] = useState<ProfessionalService[]>([]);
  const [prices, setPrices] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [name, setName] = useState("Profissional");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    async function loadPrices() {
      const supabase = createSupabaseBrowserClient();

      const {
        data: { user },
      } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

      if (!user) {
        router.replace("/login");
        return;
      }

      const { data: profile, error: profileError } = await supabase
        .from("profiles")
        .select("full_name, user_type, status")
        .eq("id", user.id)
        .maybeSingle();

      if (cancelled) {
        return;
      }

      if (profileError || !profile) {
        router.replace("/login");
        return;
      }

      if (profile.status === "blocked") {
        await supabase.auth.signOut();
        router.replace("/login");
        return;
      }

      if (profile.user_type === "client") {
        router.replace("/cliente");
        return;
      }

      if (profile.user_type === "admin") {
        router.replace("/controle");
        return;
      }

      if (profile.user_type === "company") {
        router.replace("/empresa");
        return;
      }

      if (profile.user_type !== "professional") {
        router.replace("/login");
        return;
      }

      setName(profile.full_name || "Profissional");

      const { data: servicesData, error: servicesError } =
        await supabase
          .from("professional_services")
          .select(`
            service_id,
            services (
              code,
              name
            )
          `)
          .eq("professional_id", user.id)
          .eq("is_active", true);

      if (cancelled) {
        return;
      }

      if (servicesError) {
        setError(
          `NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel carregar seus serviÃ§os: ${servicesError.message}`,
        );
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      const { data: pricesData, error: pricesError } =
        await supabase
          .from("service_prices")
          .select("service_id, price")
          .eq("professional_id", user.id)
          .eq("is_active", true);

      if (cancelled) {
        return;
      }

      if (pricesError) {
        setError(
          `NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel carregar seus preÃ§os: ${pricesError.message}`,
        );
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      const loadedServices: ProfessionalService[] = (servicesData || [])
        .map((item) => {
          const service = Array.isArray(item.services)
            ? item.services[0]
            : item.services;

          if (!service) {
            return null;
          }

          const existingPrice = (pricesData || []).find(
            (price) => price.service_id === item.service_id,
          );

          return {
            service_id: item.service_id,
            code: service.code,
            name: service.name,
            price: existingPrice?.price ?? null,
          };
        })
        .filter(
          (item): item is ProfessionalService => item !== null,
        )
        .sort((a, b) => a.code.localeCompare(b.code));

      const initialPrices: Record<string, string> = {};

      loadedServices.forEach((service) => {
        if (service.price !== null) {
          initialPrices[service.service_id] = service.price
            .toFixed(2)
            .replace(".", ",");
        } else {
          initialPrices[service.service_id] = "";
        }
      });

      if (cancelled) {
        return;
      }

      setServices(loadedServices);
      setPrices(initialPrices);
      setLoading(false);
    }

    void loadPrices();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [router]);

  function handlePriceChange(serviceId: string, value: string) {
    setMessage("");
    setError("");

    const normalized = value
      .replace(/[^\d,]/g, "")
      .replace(/(,.*),/g, "$1");

    setPrices((current) => ({
      ...current,
      [serviceId]: normalized,
    }));
  }

  async function handleSave() {
    setMessage("");
    setError("");

    for (const service of services) {
      const value = prices[service.service_id]?.trim();

      if (!value) {
        setError(
          `Informe o preÃ§o do serviÃ§o ${service.code} - ${service.name}.`,
        );
        return;
      }

      const numericValue = Number(
        value.replace(/\./g, "").replace(",", "."),
      );

      if (!Number.isFinite(numericValue) || numericValue < 0) {
        setError(
          `O preÃ§o do serviÃ§o ${service.code} Ã© invÃ¡lido.`,
        );
        return;
      }
    }

    setSaving(true);

    const supabase = createSupabaseBrowserClient();

    const {
      data: { user },
    } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

    if (!user) {
      router.replace("/login");
      return;
    }

    const { data: profile } = await supabase
      .from("profiles")
      .select("user_type, status")
      .eq("id", user.id)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (
      !profile ||
      profile.user_type !== "professional" ||
      profile.status !== "active"
    ) {
      router.replace("/login");
      return;
    }

    const { error: deactivateError } = await supabase
      .from("service_prices")
      .update({ is_active: false })
      .eq("professional_id", user.id)
      .eq("is_active", true);

    if (deactivateError) {
      setError(
        `NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel atualizar os preÃ§os: ${deactivateError.message}`,
      );
      setSaving(false);
      return;
    }

    const rows = services.map((service) => ({
      professional_id: user.id,
      service_id: service.service_id,
      price: Number(
        prices[service.service_id]
          .replace(/\./g, "")
          .replace(",", "."),
      ),
      currency: "BRL",
      valid_from: new Date().toISOString(),
      is_active: true,
    }));

    const { error: insertError } = await supabase
      .from("service_prices")
      .insert(rows);

    if (insertError) {
      setError(
        `NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel salvar os preÃ§os: ${insertError.message}`,
      );
      setSaving(false);
      return;
    }

    setMessage("PreÃ§os salvos com sucesso.");
    setSaving(false);
  }

  async function handleLogout() {
    const supabase = createSupabaseBrowserClient();

    await supabase.auth.signOut();

    router.replace("/login");
  }

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <main className="min-h-screen bg-black px-6 py-12 text-white">
        <div className="mx-auto max-w-5xl">
          Carregando preÃ§os...
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-[#0C0A09] text-white">
      <header className="border-b border-zinc-800 bg-black">
        <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-5xl items-center justify-between px-6 py-5">
          <div className="flex items-center">
            <Image
              src="/logo-vemgo.png"
              alt="VemGO"
              width={190}
              height={64}
              priority
              unoptimized
            />
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <div className="hidden text-right sm:block">
              <div className="text-xs text-zinc-500">
                PreÃ§os dos serviÃ§os
              </div>

              <div className="text-sm text-zinc-300">
                OlÃ¡,{" "}
                <span className="font-semibold text-white">
                  {name}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleLogout}
              className="rounded-xl border border-zinc-700 px-4 py-2 text-sm text-zinc-300 transition hover:border-orange-500 hover:text-orange-400"
            >
              Sair
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>

      <section className="mx-auto max-w-5xl px-6 py-10">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => router.push("/profissional")}
          className="text-sm font-semibold text-orange-400 transition hover:text-orange-300"
        >
          â† Voltar para minha Ã¡rea
        </button>

        <div className="mt-6">
          <div className="inline-flex rounded-full bg-orange-500/10 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold tracking-wide text-orange-400">
            SERVIÃ‡O RÃPIDO. PREÃ‡O CERTO. CHAMA QUE VEM!
          </div>

          <h1 className="mt-5 text-3xl font-bold">
            PreÃ§os dos serviÃ§os
          </h1>

          <p className="mt-2 max-w-3xl text-zinc-400">
            Informe o preÃ§o que serÃ¡ utilizado para cada serviÃ§o
            que vocÃª oferece pela VemGO.
          </p>
        </div>

        {error && (
          <div className="mt-6 rounded-xl border border-red-900 bg-red-950/40 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-red-300">
            {error}
          </div>
        )}

        {message && (
          <div className="mt-6 rounded-xl border border-orange-900 bg-orange-950/30 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-orange-300">
            {message}
          </div>
        )}

        {services.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="mt-8 rounded-2xl border border-zinc-800 bg-black p-8">
            <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold">
              Nenhum serviÃ§o selecionado
            </h2>

            <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-zinc-500">
              Primeiro selecione os serviÃ§os e competÃªncias que
              vocÃª oferece.
            </p>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() =>
                router.push("/profissional/servicos")
              }
              className="mt-6 rounded-xl bg-orange-500 px-5 py-3 font-semibold text-black transition hover:bg-orange-400"
            >
              Cadastrar serviÃ§os
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="mt-8 rounded-2xl border border-zinc-800 bg-black p-6">
            <div className="space-y-4">
              {services.map((service) => (
                <div
                  key={service.service_id}
                  className="flex flex-col gap-4 rounded-xl border border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-950 p-5 transition hover:border-orange-900 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between"
                >
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-orange-400">
                      {service.code}
                    </p>

                    <p className="mt-1 font-semibold text-white">
                      {service.name}
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <span className="text-sm text-zinc-500">
                      R$
                    </span>

                    <input
                      type="text"
                      inputMode="decimal"
                      value={prices[service.service_id] || ""}
                      onChange={(event) =>
                        handlePriceChange(
                          service.service_id,
                          event.target.value,
                        )
                      }
                      placeholder="0,00"
                      className="w-32 rounded-xl border border-zinc-700 bg-black px-4 py-3 text-right text-white outline-none transition focus:border-orange-500"

            <div className="mt-8 flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">

                ServiÃ§os cadastrados: {services.length}
              </p>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleSave}
                disabled={saving}
                className="rounded-xl bg-orange-500 px-6 py-3 font-semibold text-black transition hover:bg-orange-400 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                {saving ? "Salvando..." : "Salvar preÃ§os"}

"use client";

import Image from "next/image";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { createSupabaseBrowserClient } from "@/lib/supabase-browser";

type Region = {
  id: string;
  city: string;
  state: string;
  country: string;
  max_distance_km: number;
  is_active: boolean;
};

export default function ProfissionalRegioesPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const supabase = createSupabaseBrowserClient();

  const [regions, setRegions] = useState<Region[]>([]);
  const [city, setCity] = useState("");
  const [state, setState] = useState("");
  const [maxDistance, setMaxDistance] = useState("20");
  const [name, setName] = useState("Profissional");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    async function loadRegions() {
      const {
        data: { user },
      } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

      if (!user) {
        router.replace("/login");
        return;
      }

      const { data: profile } = await supabase
        .from("profiles")
        .select("full_name, user_type, status")
        .eq("id", user.id)
        .maybeSingle();

      if (!profile) {
        router.replace("/login");
        return;
      }

      if (profile.status === "blocked") {
        await supabase.auth.signOut();
        router.replace("/login");
        return;
      }

      if (profile.user_type === "client") {
        router.replace("/cliente");
        return;
      }

      if (profile.user_type === "admin") {
        router.replace("/controle");
        return;
      }

      if (profile.user_type === "company") {
        router.replace("/empresa");
        return;
      }

      if (profile.user_type !== "professional") {
        router.replace("/login");
        return;
      }

      setName(profile.full_name || "Profissional");

      const { data, error: regionsError } = await supabase
        .from("professional_regions")
        .select(
          "id, city, state, country, max_distance_km, is_active",
        )
        .eq("professional_id", user.id)
        .eq("is_active", true)
        .order("city", { ascending: true });

      if (regionsError) {
        setError(
          `NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel carregar suas regiÃµes: ${regionsError.message}`,
        );
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      setRegions(data || []);
      setLoading(false);
    }

    void Promise.resolve().then(loadRegions);
  }, [router, supabase]);

  function handleAddRegion() {
    setMessage("");
    setError("");

    const normalizedCity = city.trim();
    const normalizedState = state.trim().toUpperCase();
    const numericDistance = Number(
      maxDistance.replace(",", "."),
    );

    if (!normalizedCity) {
      setError("Informe a cidade.");
      return;
    }

    if (!normalizedState || normalizedState.length !== 2) {
      setError("Informe o estado com 2 letras. Ex.: SP.");
      return;
    }

    if (
      !Number.isFinite(numericDistance) ||
      numericDistance <= 0
    ) {
      setError("Informe uma distÃ¢ncia vÃ¡lida maior que zero.");
      return;
    }

    const alreadyExists = regions.some(
      (region) =>
        region.city.toLowerCase() ===
          normalizedCity.toLowerCase() &&
        region.state.toUpperCase() === normalizedState,
    );

    if (alreadyExists) {
      setError("Essa regiÃ£o jÃ¡ estÃ¡ cadastrada.");
      return;
    }

    setRegions((current) => [
      ...current,
      {
        id: `new-${Date.now()}-${Math.random()}`,
        city: normalizedCity,
        state: normalizedState,
        country: "BR",
        max_distance_km: numericDistance,
        is_active: true,
      },
    ]);

    setCity("");
    setState("");
    setMaxDistance("20");
  }

  function handleRemoveRegion(id: string) {
    setRegions((current) =>
      current.filter((region) => region.id !== id),
    );
  }

  async function handleSave() {
    setMessage("");
    setError("");

    if (regions.length === 0) {
      setError("Cadastre pelo menos uma regiÃ£o de atendimento.");
      return;
    }

    setSaving(true);

    const {
      data: { user },
    } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

    if (!user) {
      router.replace("/login");
      return;
    }

    const { data: profile } = await supabase
      .from("profiles")
      .select("user_type, status")
      .eq("id", user.id)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (
      !profile ||
      profile.user_type !== "professional" ||
      profile.status !== "active"
    ) {
      router.replace("/login");
      return;
    }

    const { error: deactivateError } = await supabase
      .from("professional_regions")
      .update({ is_active: false })
      .eq("professional_id", user.id)
      .eq("is_active", true);

    if (deactivateError) {
      setError(
        `NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel atualizar as regiÃµes: ${deactivateError.message}`,
      );
      setSaving(false);
      return;
    }

    const rows = regions.map((region) => ({
      professional_id: user.id,
      city: region.city,
      state: region.state,
      country: region.country,
      max_distance_km: region.max_distance_km,
      is_active: true,
    }));

    const { data: insertedRegions, error: insertError } =
      await supabase
        .from("professional_regions")
        .insert(rows)
        .select(
          "id, city, state, country, max_distance_km, is_active",

    if (insertError) {
      setError(

      setSaving(false);

    }

    setRegions(insertedRegions || []);
    setMessage("RegiÃµes de atendimento salvas com sucesso.");
    setSaving(false);
  }

  async function handleLogout() {
    await supabase.auth.signOut();
    router.replace("/login");
  }

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <main className="min-h-screen bg-[#0C0A09] px-6 py-12 text-white">
        <div className="mx-auto max-w-5xl">
          Carregando regiÃµes...

  return (

      <header className="border-b border-zinc-800 bg-black">
        <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-5xl items-center justify-between px-6 py-5">
          <div className="flex items-center">
            <Image

              alt="VemGO"
              width={190}
              height={64}
              priority
              unoptimized
            />
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <div className="hidden text-right sm:block">

                RegiÃµes de atendimento
              </div>

"use client";

import Image from "next/image";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { createSupabaseBrowserClient } from "@/lib/supabase-browser";

type Service = {
  id: string;
  code: string;
  name: string;
  description: string | null;
  is_active: boolean;
};

export default function ProfissionalServicosPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const supabase = createSupabaseBrowserClient();

  const [services, setServices] = useState<Service[]>([]);
  const [selectedServices, setSelectedServices] =
    useState<Set<string>>(new Set());

  const [name, setName] = useState("Profissional");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    async function loadServices() {
      const {
        data: { user },
      } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

      if (!user) {
        router.replace("/login");
        return;
      }

      const { data: profile } = await supabase
        .from("profiles")
        .select("full_name, user_type, status")
        .eq("id", user.id)
        .maybeSingle();

      if (!profile) {
        router.replace("/login");
        return;
      }

      if (profile.status === "blocked") {
        await supabase.auth.signOut();
        router.replace("/login");
        return;
      }

      if (profile.user_type === "client") {
        router.replace("/cliente");
        return;
      }

      if (profile.user_type === "admin") {
        router.replace("/controle");
        return;
      }

      if (profile.user_type === "company") {
        router.replace("/empresa");
        return;
      }

      if (profile.user_type !== "professional") {
        router.replace("/login");
        return;
      }

      setName(profile.full_name || "Profissional");

      const {
        data: servicesData,
        error: servicesError,
      } = await supabase
        .from("services")
        .select(
          "id, code, name, description, is_active"
        )
        .eq("is_active", true)
        .order("display_order", { ascending: true })
        .order("code", { ascending: true });

      if (servicesError) {
        setError(
          `NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel carregar os serviÃ§os: ${servicesError.message}`
        );
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      const {
        data: selectedData,
        error: selectedError,
      } = await supabase
        .from("professional_services")
        .select("service_id")
        .eq("professional_id", user.id)
        .eq("is_active", true);

      if (selectedError) {
        setError(
          `NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel carregar suas competÃªncias: ${selectedError.message}`
        );
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      setServices(servicesData || []);

      setSelectedServices(
        new Set(
          (selectedData || []).map(
            (item) => item.service_id
          )
        )
      );

      setLoading(false);
    }

    void loadServices();
  }, [router, supabase]);

  function toggleService(serviceId: string) {
    setMessage("");
    setError("");

    setSelectedServices((current) => {
      const next = new Set(current);

      if (next.has(serviceId)) {
        next.delete(serviceId);
      } else {
        next.add(serviceId);
      }

      return next;
    });
  }

  async function handleSave() {
    setMessage("");
    setError("");

    if (selectedServices.size === 0) {
      setError(
        "Selecione pelo menos um serviÃ§o que vocÃª estÃ¡ habilitado a executar."
      );
      return;
    }

    setSaving(true);

    const {
      data: { user },
    } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

    if (!user) {
      router.replace("/login");
      return;
    }

    const { data: profile } = await supabase
      .from("profiles")
      .select("user_type, status")
      .eq("id", user.id)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (
      !profile ||
      profile.user_type !== "professional" ||
      profile.status === "blocked"
    ) {
      router.replace(
        profile?.user_type === "client"
          ? "/cliente"
          : profile?.user_type === "admin"
          ? "/controle"
          : profile?.user_type === "company"
          ? "/empresa"
          : "/login"
      );
      return;
    }

    const selectedIds = Array.from(selectedServices);

    const { error: deactivateError } =
      await supabase
        .from("professional_services")
        .update({ is_active: false })
        .eq("professional_id", user.id);

    if (deactivateError) {
      setError(
        `NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel atualizar seus serviÃ§os: ${deactivateError.message}`
      );
      setSaving(false);
      return;
    }

    const rows = selectedIds.map((serviceId) => ({
      professional_id: user.id,
      service_id: serviceId,
      is_active: true,
    }));

    const { error: insertError } = await supabase
      .from("professional_services")
      .upsert(rows, {
        onConflict: "professional_id,service_id",
      });

    if (insertError) {
      setError(
        `NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel salvar suas competÃªncias: ${insertError.message}`
      );
      setSaving(false);
      return;
    }

    setMessage(
      `${selectedServices.size} serviÃ§o(s) selecionado(s) com sucesso.`
    );

    setSaving(false);
  }

  async function handleLogout() {
    await supabase.auth.signOut();
    router.replace("/login");
  }

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <main className="min-h-screen bg-stone-950 px-6 py-12 text-white">
        <div className="mx-auto max-w-5xl">
          Carregando serviÃ§os...
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-stone-950 text-white">
      <header className="border-b border-stone-800 bg-black">
        <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-5xl items-center justify-between gap-6 px-6 py-4">
          <div className="flex items-center">
            <Image
              src="/logo-vemgo.png"
              alt="VemGO"
              width={360}
              height={200}
              className="h-auto w-[190px] object-contain"
              priority
            />
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <div className="hidden text-right sm:block">
              <p className="text-xs text-stone-500">
                ServiÃ§os e competÃªncias
              </p>

              <p className="text-sm text-stone-300">
                OlÃ¡,{" "}
                <span className="font-semibold text-white">
                  {name}
                </span>
              </p>
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleLogout}
              className="rounded-xl border border-stone-700 px-4 py-2 text-sm text-stone-300 transition hover:border-orange-500 hover:text-orange-400"
            >
              Sair
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>

      <section className="mx-auto max-w-5xl px-6 py-10">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => router.push("/profissional")}
          className="text-sm font-semibold text-orange-500 hover:text-orange-400"
        >
          â† Voltar para minha Ã¡rea
        </button>

        <div className="mt-6">
          <div className="mb-5 inline-flex rounded-full bg-orange-50 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-orange-600">
            SERVIÃ‡O RÃPIDO. PREÃ‡O CERTO. CHAMA QUE VEM!
          </div>

          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold">
            ServiÃ§os e competÃªncias

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { createSupabaseBrowserClient } from "@/lib/supabase-browser";

export default function RedefinirSenhaPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const supabase = createSupabaseBrowserClient();

  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] =
    useState("");

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [checking, setChecking] = useState(true);

  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    async function checkSession() {
      const {
        data: { session },
      } = await supabase.auth.getSession();

      if (!session) {
        setError(
          "O link de recuperaÃ§Ã£o Ã© invÃ¡lido ou expirou.",
        );
      }

      setChecking(false);
    }

    void checkSession();
  }, [supabase]);

  async function handleUpdatePassword(
    event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>,
  ) {
    event.preventDefault();

    setError("");
    setMessage("");

    if (password.length < 8) {
      setError(
        "A senha precisa ter pelo menos 8 caracteres.",
      );
      return;
    }

    if (password !== confirmPassword) {
      setError("As senhas nÃ£o conferem.");
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);

    const { error: updateError } =
      await supabase.auth.updateUser({
        password,
      });

    if (updateError) {
      setError(
        `NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel atualizar a senha: ${updateError.message}`,
      );
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    setMessage(
      "Senha alterada com sucesso. VocÃª serÃ¡ direcionado para o login.",
    );

    setLoading(false);

    setTimeout(() => {
      router.replace("/login");
    }, 1500);
  }

  if (checking) {
    return (
      <main className="flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center bg-zinc-950 text-white">
        <p className="text-sm text-zinc-400">
          Validando link de recuperaÃ§Ã£o...
        </p>

    );

  return (

        <div className="mb-8 text-center">
          <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-emerald-400">
            VemGO
          </div>

          <h1 className="mt-6 text-3xl font-bold">
            Nova senha
          </h1>

          <p className="mt-2 text-zinc-400">
            Cadastre uma nova senha para sua conta.
          </p>
        </div>

        <form
          onSubmit={handleUpdatePassword}
          className="rounded-2xl border border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-900/40 p-6"
        >
          <label
            htmlFor="password"
            className="text-sm font-medium text-zinc-200"
          >
            Nova senha
          </label>

          <input
            id="password"
            type="password"
            autoComplete="new-password"
            value={password}
            onChange={(event) =>
              setPassword(event.target.value)
            }
            required
            className="mt-2 w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-900 px-4 py-3 text-white outline-none transition focus:border-emerald-500"
          />

          <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-zinc-500">

          <label

            Confirmar nova senha

import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type BadgeVariant =
  | "neutral"
  | "success"
  | "warning"
  | "danger"
  | "green"
  | "orange"
  | "blue";

interface BadgeProps {
  children: ReactNode;
  variant?: BadgeVariant;
}

const variants: Record<BadgeVariant, string> = {
  neutral: "bg-white/5 text-text-secondary border-white/10",
  success: "bg-success-soft text-success border-success/20",
  warning: "bg-warning-soft text-warning border-warning/20",
  danger: "bg-danger-soft text-danger border-danger/20",
  green: "bg-vemgo-green-soft text-vemgo-green border-vemgo-green-border",
  orange:
    "bg-vemgo-orange-soft text-vemgo-orange border-vemgo-orange-border",
  blue: "bg-vemgo-blue-soft text-vemgo-blue border-vemgo-blue-border",
};

export function Badge({
  children,
  variant = "neutral",
}: BadgeProps) {
  return (
    <span
      className={[
        "inline-flex items-center rounded-full border",
        "px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium",
        variants[variant],
      ].join(" ")}
    >
      {children}
    </span>
  );
}

import type { ButtonHTMLAttributes } from "react";

type ButtonVariant =
  | "primary"
  | "secondary"
  | "ghost"
  | "danger"
  | "professional"
  | "control";

type ButtonSize = "sm" | "md" | "lg";

interface ButtonProps extends ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  variant?: ButtonVariant;
  size?: ButtonSize;
  loading?: boolean;
  fullWidth?: boolean;
}

const variantClasses: Record<ButtonVariant, string> = {
  primary:
    "bg-vemgo-green text-white hover:bg-vemgo-green-hover focus-visible:ring-vemgo-green",

  secondary:
    "border border-white/10 bg-surface-2 text-text-primary hover:bg-surface-3 focus-visible:ring-vemgo-green",

  ghost:
    "bg-transparent text-text-secondary hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-text-primary focus-visible:ring-vemgo-green",

  danger:
    "bg-danger text-white hover:bg-red-500 focus-visible:ring-danger",

  professional:
    "bg-vemgo-orange text-white hover:bg-vemgo-orange-hover focus-visible:ring-vemgo-orange",

  control:
    "bg-vemgo-blue text-white hover:bg-vemgo-blue-hover focus-visible:ring-vemgo-blue",
};

const sizeClasses: Record<ButtonSize, string> = {
  sm: "min-h-9 px-3 text-sm",
  md: "min-h-11 px-4 text-sm",
  lg: "min-h-12 px-6 text-base",
};

export function Button({
  children,
  variant = "primary",
  size = "md",
  loading = false,
  fullWidth = false,
  disabled,
  className = "",
  type = "button",
  ...props
}: ButtonProps) {
  const isDisabled = disabled || loading;

  return (
    <button
      {...props}
      type={type}
      disabled={isDisabled}
      aria-busy={loading}
      className={[
        "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2",
        "rounded-md",
        "font-medium",
        "transition-colors duration-180",
        "focus-visible:outline-none",
        "focus-visible:ring-2",
        "focus-visible:ring-offset-2",
        "focus-visible:ring-offset-background",
        "disabled:pointer-events-none",
        "disabled:opacity-50",
        "select-none",
        variantClasses[variant],
        sizeClasses[size],
        fullWidth ? "w-full" : "",
        className,
      ]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(" ")}
    >
      {loading ? (
        <>
          <span
            aria-hidden="true"
            className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin rounded-full border-2 border-white/30 border-t-white"
          />
          <span>{children}</span>
        </>
      ) : (
        children
      )}
    </button>
  );
}

import type { InputHTMLAttributes } from "react";

interface InputProps extends InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement> {
  label?: string;
  error?: string;
  hint?: string;
  fullWidth?: boolean;
}

export function Input({
  label,
  error,
  hint,
  fullWidth = true,
  id,
  className = "",
  ...props
}: InputProps) {
  const inputId = id ?? props.name;

  return (
    <div className={fullWidth ? "w-full" : ""}>
      {label && (
        <label
          htmlFor={inputId}
          className="mb-2 block text-sm font-medium text-text-primary"
        >
          {label}
        </label>
      )}

      <input
        {...props}
        id={inputId}
        aria-invalid={Boolean(error)}
        aria-describedby={
          error
            ? `${inputId}-error`
            : hint
              ? `${inputId}-hint`
              : undefined
        }
        className={[
          "min-h-11 rounded-md border bg-surface-2 px-3.5",
          "text-base text-text-primary",
          "placeholder:text-text-tertiary",
          "transition-colors duration-180",
          "outline-none",
          "focus:border-vemgo-green",
          "focus:ring-2 focus:ring-vemgo-green/20",
          "disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50",
          error
            ? "border-danger focus:border-danger focus:ring-danger/20"
            : "border-white/10 hover:border-white/20",
          fullWidth ? "w-full" : "",
          className,
        ]
          .filter(Boolean)
          .join(" ")}
      />

      {error && (
        <p
          id={`${inputId}-error`}
          className="mt-2 text-sm text-danger"
          role="alert"
        >
          {error}
        </p>
      )}

      {!error && hint && (
        <p
          id={`${inputId}-hint`}
          className="mt-2 text-xs text-text-tertiary"
        >
          {hint}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

ARQUIVO: components\ui\Progress.tsx
================================================================================
interface ProgressProps {
  value: number;
  max?: number;
  label?: string;
  showValue?: boolean;
  variant?: "green" | "orange" | "blue";
}

const variants = {
  green: "bg-vemgo-green",
  orange: "bg-vemgo-orange",
  blue: "bg-vemgo-blue",
};

export function Progress({
  value,
  max = 100,
  label,
  showValue = false,
  variant = "green",
}: ProgressProps) {
  const percentage = Math.min(
    100,
    Math.max(0, (value / max) * 100),
  );

  return (
    <div className="w-full">
      {(label || showValue) && (
        <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
          {label && (
            <span className="text-sm text-text-secondary">
              {label}
            </span>
          )}

          {showValue && (
            <span className="text-xs font-medium tabular-nums text-text-tertiary">
              {Math.round(percentage)}%
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      <div
        className="h-1.5 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-white/10"
        role="progressbar"
        aria-valuenow={Math.round(percentage)}
        aria-valuemin={0}
        aria-valuemax={100}
      >
        <div
          className={[
            "h-full rounded-full transition-[width] duration-300",
            variants[variant],
          ].join(" ")}
          style={{ width: `${percentage}%` }}
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

interface OnboardingStepperProps {
  currentStep: number;
  totalSteps?: number;
}

const stepLabels = [
  "Dados",
  "EndereÃ§o",
  "Foto",
  "Identidade",
  "CompetÃªncias",
  "PreÃ§os",
  "Disponibilidade",
  "Ãrea",
  "Plano",
];

export function OnboardingStepper({
  currentStep,
  totalSteps = 9,
}: OnboardingStepperProps) {
  return (
    <div className="w-full">
      <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between">
        <span className="text-sm font-medium text-text-primary">
          Etapa {currentStep} de {totalSteps}
        </span>

        <span className="text-xs text-text-tertiary">
          {Math.round((currentStep / totalSteps) * 100)}%
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
        {stepLabels.slice(0, totalSteps).map((label, index) => {
          const step = index + 1;

          const completed = step < currentStep;
          const active = step === currentStep;

          return (
            <div
              key={label}
              className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-2"
            >
              <div
                className={[
                  "h-1.5 rounded-full transition-colors duration-180",
                  completed || active
                    ? "bg-vemgo-orange"
                    : "bg-white/10",
                ].join(" ")}
              />

              <span
                className={[
                  "hidden truncate text-[11px] sm:block",
                  active
                    ? "font-medium text-vemgo-orange"
                    : completed
                      ? "text-text-secondary"
                      : "text-text-tertiary",
                ].join(" ")}
              >
                {label}
              </span>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export const PROFESSIONAL_ONBOARDING_STEPS = {
  DATA: 1,
  ADDRESS: 2,
  PHOTO: 3,
  IDENTITY: 4,
  COMPETENCIES: 5,
  PRICES: 6,
  AVAILABILITY: 7,
  SERVICE_AREA: 8,
  PLAN: 9,
} as const;

export const PROFESSIONAL_ONBOARDING_TOTAL_STEPS = 9;

export function getProfessionalOnboardingRoute(step: number) {
  const routes: Record<number, string> = {
    1: "/cadastro-profissional",
    2: "/cadastro-profissional/endereco",
    3: "/cadastro-profissional/foto",
    4: "/cadastro-profissional/identidade",
    5: "/cadastro-profissional/competencias",
    6: "/cadastro-profissional/precos",
    7: "/cadastro-profissional/disponibilidade",
    8: "/cadastro-profissional/area-atendimento",
    9: "/cadastro-profissional/plano",
  };

  return routes[step] ?? routes[2];
}

export function getNextProfessionalOnboardingStep(
  currentStep: number,
) {
  return Math.min(
    currentStep + 1,
    PROFESSIONAL_ONBOARDING_TOTAL_STEPS,
  );
}

This is a [Next.js](https://nextjs.org) project bootstrapped with [`create-next-app`](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/cli/create-next-app).

## Getting Started

First, run the development server:

```bash
npm run dev
# or
yarn dev
# or
pnpm dev
# or
bun dev
```

Open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000) with your browser to see the result.

You can start editing the page by modifying `app/page.tsx`. The page auto-updates as you edit the file.

This project uses [`next/font`](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/optimizing/fonts) to automatically optimize and load [Geist](https://vercel.com/font), a new font family for Vercel.

## Learn More

To learn more about Next.js, take a look at the following resources:

- [Next.js Documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs) - learn about Next.js features and API.
- [Learn Next.js](https://nextjs.org/learn) - an interactive Next.js tutorial.

You can check out [the Next.js GitHub repository](https://github.com/vercel/next.js) - your feedback and contributions are welcome!

## Deploy on Vercel

The easiest way to deploy your Next.js app is to use the [Vercel Platform](https://vercel.com/new?utm_medium=default-template&filter=next.js&utm_source=create-next-app&utm_campaign=create-next-app-readme) from the creators of Next.js.

Check out our [Next.js deployment documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/deploying) for more details.
